title: Tragic death of woman who testified against father in notorious mafia murder of mother
english: Denise Cosco, who bravely testified against her father for the mafia-related murder of her mother in 2009, has died by suicide at age 35. Despite living under state protection for years, she struggled with the deep emotional trauma and complex family ties caused by her father's criminal legacy. Her passing serves as a tragic reminder of the lasting mental health impacts faced by those who turn against organized crime syndicates.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2009 እናቷን በገደለው አባቷ ላይ ምስክርነት የሰጠችው ዴኒስ ኮስኮ በ35 ዓመቷ ራሷን አጠፋች። ለብዙ ዓመታት በመንግስት ጥበቃ ስር ብትኖርም፣ በአባቷ የወንጀል ድርጊት ምክንያት የደረሰባትን ከባድ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ እና የቤተሰብ እሰር ማሸነፍ ተስኗት ነበር። ሞቷ፣ በማፊያ ቡድኖች ላይ ለሚመሰክሩ ሰዎች የሚደረገው የረጅም ጊዜ የስነ-ልቦና ድጋፍ ምን ያህል አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ አሳዛኝ ማሳያ ሆኗል።
oromo: Dubartiin bara 2009 haadha ishee ajjeese jechuun abbaa ishee irratti ragaa baate, Deenis Koskoo, umurii waggaa 35tti of ajjeesite. Waggoota hedduuf eegumsa mootummaa jalatti kan jiraatte ta'us, miidhaa sammuu abbaa ishee irraa ishee ga'eefi qormaata maatii ishee mo'achuun ishee rakkisee ture. Duuti ishee kun, namoonni garee yakkaatiin falman jireenya isaanii guutuu deeggarsa sammuu akka barbaadan kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Passenger train derails in France leaving at least 44 injured
english: A passenger train traveling between Rouen and Caen in northern France derailed, resulting in injuries to at least 44 people. One young woman remains in critical condition following the accident, which involved approximately 180 passengers. Emergency responders have been deployed to the site near Cléon, and authorities are currently investigating the cause of the crash.
amharic: በሰሜን ፈረንሳይ በሩየን እና በካን ከተሞች መካከል ይጓዝ የነበረ የባቡር ትራንስፖርት ከሀዲዱ በመውጣቱ ቢያንስ 44 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ከአደጋው በኋላ አንዲት ወጣት በከባድ ሁኔታ ሆስፒታል የገባች ሲሆን በአጠቃላይ 180 መንገደኞች በባቡሩ ውስጥ ነበሩ። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ወደ ስፍራው የተሰማሩ ሲሆን ባለስልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማጣራት ምርመራ ጀምረዋል።
oromo: Faransaayi kaabaatti baaburri imaltootaa magaalaalee Rouen fi Caen gidduutti deemu tokko karaa irraa waan baheef namoonni 44 ol ta’an miidhaniiru. Imaltoota 180 keessaa dargaggeettiin tokko haala cimaa keessa kan jirtu yoo tahu, gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa gara iddoo balaa kanaatti bobbaaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa balaa kana hordofee sababa inni itti uumame qorachaa jiru.

title: Arrest made over the death of black woman found hanged from tree
english: Police in Mississippi have arrested 51-year-old Jarques Ratliff and charged him with the murder of Tasia Fortune, a Black woman discovered hanged in Jackson last month. Authorities confirmed the death is being investigated as a homicide and indicated that more arrests may follow as the inquiry continues. While the victim's mother expressed a small sense of relief, the community remains deeply concerned due to the city's history of racial violence and initial frustrations over the police investigation's pace.
amharic: የሚሲሲፒ ፖሊስ ባለፈው ወር በጃክሰን ከተማ ዛፍ ላይ ተንጠልጥላ የተገኘችውን ታሲያ ፎርቹን በተባለች ጥቁር ሴት ግድያ ወንጀል የ51 ዓመቱን ጃርኩዌስ ራትሊፍ በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ባለስልጣናት የሴትየዋ ሞት ግድያ መሆኑን አረጋግጠው፣ ምርመራው እንደቀጠለ በመሆኑ ተጨማሪ ሰዎች ሊታሰሩ እንደሚችሉ ገልጸዋል። የግድያው ሁኔታ በከተማው ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ስጋት የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ የሟች እናት በቁጥጥር ስር መዋሉ እፎይታ ቢሰጣቸውም፣ የፖሊስ ምርመራ ቀደም ብሎ በነበረው የዝግታ ሂደት ቅሬታቸውን ሲገልጹ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Poolisiin naannoo Mississippi namicha umriin isaa 51 ta'e Jarques Ratliff jedhamu, ajjeechaa Tasiya Forchuun jedhamtu kan ji'a darbe magaalaa Jaaksonitti muka irratti fannifamtee argamte irratti himatee to'annoo jala oolche. Aangonni akka ibsanitti duuti ishee kun ajjeechaa akka ta'e mirkanaa'eera, qorannoon itti fufee waan jiruufis namoonni biroo akka qabaman ibsameera. Ajjeechaan kun hawaasa keessatti sodaa guddaa kan uume yoo ta'u, haati ishee to'annoo jala oolchuun isaa tasgabbii xinnoo akka isheedhaaf kenne ibsitee jirti; ta'us, qorannoo poolisii dursee turee irratti komiin jiraachuun isaa ni beekama.

title: Passenger train derails in France, leaving 44 injured, 1 critical
english: A passenger train traveling between Rouen and Caen in northwestern France derailed on Friday, leaving 44 people injured. One individual remains in critical condition and was airlifted to a hospital, while emergency crews have secured the scene. Authorities have suspended rail traffic in the area and are currently investigating the cause of the accident.
amharic: በሰሜን ምዕራብ ፈረንሳይ በሮየን እና በካን ከተሞች መካከል ሲጓዝ የነበረ የባቡር ተሳፋሪዎች ከሀዲዱ በመውጣቱ 44 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። አንዲት ወጣት በከባድ ሁኔታ ላይ በመሆኗ በሄሊኮፕተር ወደ ሆስፒታል የተወሰደች ሲሆን፣ የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በቦታው ተገኝተው ድጋፍ እየሰጡ ይገኛል። የባቡር አገልግሎቱ ለጊዜው የተቋረጠ ሲሆን ባለስልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ ጀምረዋል።
oromo: Faransaatti baaburri abbaa manaa Rouen fi Caen gidduutti imalaa ture kaadidoo irraa gombifamuun namoota 44 miidheera. Namni tokko haala hamaa keessa waan jiruuf xiyyaaraan gara hospitaalaatti ergamuu fi gargaarsi ariifachiisaan tasifamuu gabaafameera. Tajaajilli baaburaa iddoo sanatti dhaabbatee jiraachuu fi aangotni dhimma kana irratti qorannoo eegaluu beekameera.

title: Former top US diplomat reveals mistakes made after 9/11 attacks
english: Former senior diplomat Zalmay Khalilzad reflected on the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks by identifying critical errors in U.S. foreign policy. He explained that a climate of intense national anger and fear following the attacks pressured the government into impulsive military decisions. Khalilzad specifically noted that rejecting early negotiations with the Taliban was a major missed opportunity that prolonged the conflict for two decades.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ከፍተኛ ዲፕሎማት ዘልመይ ካሊልዛድ የሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት 25ኛ ዓመት መታሰቢያን ምክንያት በማድረግ በአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ላይ የተፈጸሙ ስህተቶችን ገምግመዋል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ በሀገሪቱ የነበረው ከፍተኛ ቁጣና ስጋት መንግስትን ወደ ፈጣንና ያልታሰቡ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች እንደገፋው ተናግረዋል። በተለይም በወቅቱ ከታሊባን ጋር ድርድር ላለማድረግ የተወሰነው ውሳኔ ትልቅ ዕድልን ያሳለፈና ጦርነቱ ለሁለት አስርት ዓመታት እንዲራዘም ያደረገ ስህተት እንደነበር ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Diplomaatichi olaanaa turan Zalmay Khalilzad, yaadannoo waggaa 25ffaa haleellaa Sadaasa 11 irratti akka ibsanitti, siyaasni alaa Ameerikaa yeroo sana dogoggoroota gurguddoo qaba ture. Haleellaa sana booda aariin biyya keessaa fi sodaan cimaan mootummaan tarkaanfii waraanaa ariifataa fi hin yaadamne akka fudhatu godheera jedhaniiru. Keessattuu, jalqaba irratti garee Taaliiban waliin mari’achuu diduun carraa guddaa badee fi waraanichi waggoota 20f akka dheeratu taasiseera jechuun ibsaniiru.

title: Iran war live: Houthis control Red Sea coast, Saudi pipeline shut down
english: Houthi forces have gained total control over the Red Sea coastline in Yemen after quickly advancing against government troops. In a separate development, Saudi Arabia halted operations on its primary oil pipeline following a drone strike that was launched from within Iraq. The Iraqi government has launched an investigation and dismissed a military commander in response to the attack.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በመንግስት ኃይሎች ላይ ባደረጉት ፈጣን ጥቃት የየመንን የቀይ ባህር የባህር ዳርቻ ሙሉ በሙሉ መቆጣጠር ችለዋል። በተመሳሳይ፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ ከኢራቅ በተነሱ ድሮኖች የተፈጸመባትን ጥቃት ተከትሎ ዋናውን የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመር በጊዜያዊነት ዘግታለች። የኢራቅ መንግስት ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ ምርመራ የጀመረ ሲሆን አንድ የጦር አዛዥንም ከስልጣን አንስቷል።
oromo: Humnoonni Huutii mootummaa Yemenirratti tarkaanfii ariifataa fudhachuun daangaa galaana diimaa guutummaatti to'ataniiru. Gama biraatiin, Sa'udii Arabiyaan mi'a xiyyaaraa kanaan dura Iraaq irraa ka'een boombii ergameef erga rukutamtee booda, gaazii ishee erguu dhaabdeetti. Mootummaan Iraaqis qorannoo eegaluun ajajaa waraanaa tokko hojiirraa ari'eera.

title: UN extends partial Sudan arms embargo for a month
english: The UN Security Council has unanimously agreed to extend the existing arms embargo on Sudan's Darfur region for one month. This short-term measure provides additional time for members to discuss a US-led proposal to enforce a nationwide arms ban aimed at curbing the ongoing civil conflict. However, the plan faces significant opposition from Russia, which has vowed to block any expansion of the sanctions beyond the Darfur area.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፀጥታው ምክር ቤት በሱዳን ዳርፉር ክልል ላይ ሲጣል የነበረውን የጦር መሳሪያ እገዳ ለአንድ ወር ለማራዘም በአንድ ድምፅ ወስኗል። ይህ አጭር ጊዜ ለሀገሪቱ በሙሉ የጦር መሳሪያ እገዳ ለመጣል በአሜሪካ የቀረበውን ሀሳብ ለመወያየት ተጨማሪ ጊዜ ይሰጣል። ይሁን እንጂ ሩሲያ ማዕቀቡ ከዳርፉር ውጭ እንዲስፋፋ እንደማትፈቅድ በመግለጿ በጉዳዩ ላይ አለመግባባቶች አሉ።
oromo: Manni Maree Nageenyaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii naannoo Daarfuritti meeshaalee waraanaa galchu irratti dhorkaa ture ji'a tokkoof dheeressuuf sagalee tokkoon murteesseera. Murteen kun biyyattii guutuutti dhorkaa meeshaalee waraanaa hojiirra oolchuuf yaadni Ameerikaan dhiyeessite akka mariatamuuf yeroo dabalata. Haa ta'u malee, Rashiyaan dhorkaan kun naannoo Daarfurii ol akka hin babal'anne waan mormiteef, mariin kun rakkoo keessa jira.

title: Flavio Bolsonaro faces corruption probe weeks before Brazil election
english: Senator Flavio Bolsonaro is currently being investigated for alleged corruption, money laundering, and tax evasion linked to a major financial scandal involving banker Daniel Vorcaro. Authorities are examining suspicious fund transfers to a film project associated with the Bolsonaro family that may be tied to Vorcaro's fraudulent banking activities. These legal developments occur just before the upcoming presidential election, placing significant pressure on the senator's campaign.
amharic: ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ ከባንክ ሰራተኛ ዳንኤል ቮርካሮ ጋር በተያያዘ በተፈጠረ የሙስና፣ የገንዘብ ማጠብ እና የግብር ማጭበርበር ወንጀል ምርመራ እየተደረገባቸው ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናት በቦልሶናሮ ቤተሰብ የፊልም ፕሮጀክት ላይ የተደረገ ጥርጣሬ ያለበት የገንዘብ ዝውውር ከባንክ ማጭበርበሩ ጋር የተያያዘ መሆኑን እያጣሩ ነው። ይህ ህጋዊ ሂደት በምርጫው ዋዜማ እየተካሄደ መሆኑ ለሴናተሩ የፖለቲካ ዘመቻ ትልቅ ፈተና ሆኗል።
oromo: Senator Flavio Bolsonaro yakka malaammaltummaa, maallaqa seeraan ala dhiqachuu fi gibira baqachuu jedhuun qorannoon irratti banameera; kunis kan walqabatu hojjettaa baankii duraanii Daniel Vorcaro waliin dha. Qorattoonni maallaqni gara pirojektii fiilmii maatii Bolsonaro biratti ergame sun gocha farra-seeraa baankicha waliin walqabatuu fi dhiisuu isaa sakatta'aa jiru. Adeemsi seeraa kun filannoo biyyattii dura guyyoota muraasa keessa dhufuun isaa, duula siyaasaa senatarichaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumee jira.

title: Israeli demolitions threaten schools and homes in Masafer Yatta
english: Israeli authorities have intensified demolition operations in Masafer Yatta, destroying Palestinian homes, essential water infrastructure, and solar panels. These actions have also targeted local schools, with military bulldozers damaging classrooms despite pleas from educators and the United Nations. Families in the region remain in a state of constant instability as they struggle to maintain their right to education and housing under restrictive Israeli planning policies.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በማሳፈር ያታ አካባቢ የፍልስጤማውያንን መኖሪያ ቤቶች፣ የውሃ መሰረተ ልማቶችን እና የፀሐይ ኃይል ማመንጫዎችን በማፍረስ ላይ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች ትምህርት ቤቶችንም ያካተቱ ሲሆን፣ ወታደራዊ ቡልዶዘሮች የትምህርት ክፍሎችን አውድመዋል። በአካባቢው የሚገኙ ቤተሰቦች በእስራኤል የግንባታ ፖሊሲዎች ሳቢያ የመኖሪያ ቤት እና የትምህርት መብታቸውን ለማስከበር ከፍተኛ ፈተና እየገጠማቸው ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el ganda Masaafar Yattaa keessatti manneen jireenyaa, bu'uuraalee misooma bishaanii fi meeshaalee anniisaa aduu diiguun miidhaa guddaa geessisaa jira. Ijaarsawwan kun manneen barnootaas kan ilaallatu yoo ta'u, buldoozaroonni waraanaa kutaa barnootaa diiguun barattoota miidheera. Jiraattonni naannichaa imaanaa ijaarsa Israa'el irraa kan ka'e, mirga barumsaa fi mana jireenyaa isaanii kabajchiisuuf rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Saudi Arabia says East-West pipeline hit by drones launched from Iraq
english: Saudi Arabia’s East-West oil pipeline was recently damaged by drone strikes originating from Iraq, forcing a temporary shutdown of the facility and causing some injuries. While Saudi Arabia condemned the attack, it has agreed to hold off on immediate retaliation to allow the Iraqi government time to address security lapses within its own borders. Iraq has officially denounced the aggression and responded by dismissing a senior military commander responsible for the province where the drones were launched.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ የምስራቅ-ምዕራብ የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመር ከኢራቅ በተላኩ ድሮኖች ጥቃት ደርሶበት ጉዳት የደረሰ ሲሆን ይህም መስመሩ እንዲዘጋ አድርጓል። ሳውዲ አረቢያ ጥቃቱን በጽኑ ብትቃወምም፣ የኢራቅ መንግስት በአገሩ ውስጥ ያሉ የጸጥታ ክፍተቶችን እንዲያስተካክል ጊዜ ለመስጠት ሲባል አጸፋዊ እርምጃ ከመውሰድ ተቆጥባለች። ኢራቅ ጥቃቱን በይፋ ያወገዘች ሲሆን ድሮኖቹ ከተላኩበት ግዛት ጋር በተያያዘ የጦር አዛዡን ከስልጣን አንስታለች።
oromo: Itti hidhiin boba'aa bahaa fi dhihaa Sa'udii Arabaa xiyyara malee kan irraa fagaatanii to'ataman (drones) Iraaq keessaa dhufaniin miidhamee ture, kunis miidhaa qaamaa fi cufiinsa iddoo sanaa fideera. Sa'udiin haleellaa kana balaaleffattu illee, mootummaan Iraaq daangaa isaa keessatti tasgabbii uumuuf carraa akka argatuuf jedhee battalatti deebii waraanaa kennuurraa of qusattee jirti. Iraaq haleellaa kana kan balaaleffatte yoo ta'u, xiyyaroonni sun bakka itti bobbaafaman kan to'atu ajajaa waraanaa irraa aangoo irraa kaasuun tarkaanfii fudhatteetti.

title: Sabalenka vs Rybakina: US Open women’s singles final – start, prize, form
english: The 2026 US Open women's singles final will feature a high-stakes match between two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka and the incoming world number one, Elena Rybakina. The game is scheduled for Saturday at the Arthur Ashe Stadium in New York. Sabalenka is aiming to secure her third consecutive title, while Rybakina looks to claim her first US Open victory after overtaking Sabalenka in the world rankings.
amharic: የ2026 የዩኤስ ኦፕን የሴቶች የነጠላ ፍጻሜ ውድድር ሁለት ጊዜ የሻምፒዮንነት ክብሩን የያዘችው አሪና ሳባሌንካ እና ቀጣይ የዓለም ቁጥር አንድ ተጫዋች ኤሌና ሪባኪናን ያገናኛል። ጨዋታው ቅዳሜ በኒውዮርክ አርተር አሼ ስታዲየም የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ ሳባሌንካ ለሶስተኛ ተከታታይ ጊዜ ዋንጫውን ለማንሳት ትጥራለች። በበኩሏ ሪባኪና በዓለም ደረጃ አሰጣጥ ሳባሌንካን በመቅደም፣ የመጀመሪያውን የዩኤስ ኦፕን ድል ለመቀዳጀት ትጫወታለች።
oromo: Fiinaliin dorgommii ispoortii tenisii dubartoota US Open bara 2026, qophii cimaa kan ta'e gidduu shaampiyoonaa yeroo lamaa Aryna Sabalenka fi taphataa addunyaa sadarkaa tokkoffaa haaraa ta'uuf jirtu Elena Rybakina gidduutti kan taasifamu ta'a. Taphichi guyyaa Dilbataatti dirree Arthur Ashe Stadium kan qabame yoo ta'u, Sabalenka yeroo sadaffaaf walitti aansitee injifachuuf qophoofteetti. Gamtaan immoo Rybakina, sadarkaa addunyaarratti Sabalenka dabarsitee erga argattee booda, injifannoo US Open isa jalqabaa galmeessuuf carraaqxiin gooti.

title: Razaullah’s six-hitting debut caps Pakistan’s fightback against England
english: In the third Test match against England, debutant Razaullah led a spirited Pakistan comeback with an explosive 81 runs off 63 balls, including nine sixes. Supported by Mohammad Abbas, he helped lift Pakistan to a 130-run lead by the end of the third day. Although England dominated the series, this late surge ensures the match continues into Saturday.
amharic: በእንግሊዝ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል በሚካሄደው ሦስተኛው የቴስት ጨዋታ፣ አዲስ ተጫዋች የሆነው ረዛኡላህ ዘጠኝ ስድስት ነጥቦችን በማስመዝገብ ፓኪስታን ውጤቷን እንድታሻሽል ረድቷል። ከመሐመድ አባስ ጋር በመጣመር በሦስተኛው ቀን መጨረሻ ፓኪስታን የ130 ነጥብ መሪነትን እንድትይዝ አስችለዋል። እንግሊዝ ተከታታይ ጨዋታዎችን በበላይነት ብትመራም፣ የፓኪስታን ጠንካራ ብቃት ጨዋታው እስከ ቅዳሜ እንዲቀጥል አድርጎታል።
oromo: Tapha tiri-tiri sadaffaa Ingilizii fi Paakistaan gidduutti godhameen, taphataan haaraan Raza'ullaah jedhamu rukuttaa 'six' sagalii fi bu'aa 81 galchuun Paakistaan injifannoo argachuuf akka carraaqxu taasiseera. Inni Mohaammad Abbaas wajjin ta'uun guyyaa sadaffaatti Paakistaan qabxii 130 akka dursitu gargaareera. Ingilizni taphicharratti ol aantummaa qabaatus, qabsoon Paakistaan kun taphichi hanga guyyaa Sanbataatti akka itti fufu godheera.

title: Can BRICS help reshape global order by strengthening emerging economies?
english: Leaders from 11 BRICS nations are gathering in New Delhi to discuss strengthening emerging economies and rebalancing the global order. The summit faces significant challenges, particularly the ongoing conflict involving Iran, which tests the bloc's internal unity given the presence of both Iran and its regional rivals. Additionally, members are addressing global trade instability caused by recent US tariff policies and energy disruptions.
amharic: የ11ቱ የብሪክስ (BRICS) አባል ሀገራት መሪዎች በማደግ ላይ ያሉ ኢኮኖሚዎችን ለማጠናከር እና ዓለም አቀፋዊ የኃይል ሚዛንን ለመቀየር በኒው ዴልሂ ተሰብስበዋል። አባል ሀገራቱ በአሁኑ ወቅት በኢራን እና በክልሉ ባሉ ተቀናቃኞቿ መካከል ያለው ውጥረት በቡድኑ አንድነት ላይ የሚፈጥረውን ፈተና ለመቋቋም እየመከሩ ነው። በተጨማሪም መሪዎቹ በአሜሪካ የንግድ ፖሊሲዎች እና በኃይል አቅርቦት መስተጓጎል ሳቢያ በተፈጠረው ዓለም አቀፍ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ላይ ውይይት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni biyyoota miseensa BRICS 11 ta'an diinagdee biyyoota guddatanii jiran cimsuuf fi tartiiba addunyaa haaromsuuf Niiw Deelhiitti walga'ii gaggeessaa jiru. Walga'iin kun walitti bu'iinsa gara fuulduraa Iran fi biyyoota ollaa ishee gidduutti uumamee jiruun kan wal qabatu ta'ee, kunis tokkummaa garee kanaa qoruu danda'a. Kana malees, hoggantoonni kunneen dhiibbaa siyaasa daldala US fi rakkoo dhiyeessii anniisaa addunyaa irra gahu irratti mari'achaa jiru.

title: Hot pursuit: Man who robbed Indian bank using chilli powder arrested
english: A man was recently arrested in Nagpur, India, after he robbed a bank by throwing chilli powder at staff members to blind them. The suspect managed to steal approximately $4,200 during the attack. Fortunately, local police were able to locate the individual and recover all the stolen money within half an hour of the crime.
amharic: በህንድ ናግፑር ከተማ አንድ ግለሰብ የባንክ ሰራተኞችን በአይናቸው ላይ በርበሬ በመነስነስ በማስፈራራት ወደ 4,200 ዶላር ዘርፎ ነበር። ይሁን እንጂ ፖሊስ ወንጀለኛው ድርጊቱን በፈጸመ በ30 ደቂቃ ውስጥ እሱን መያዝ ችሏል። የተሰረቀው ገንዘብ በሙሉ በህግ አካላት ቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል።
oromo: Namichi tokko magaala Nagpuur kan Hindii keessatti argamuutti, hojjettoota baankii irratti daakuu mirsii facaasuudhaan qarshii 4,200 ta'u saamatee ture. Ta'us, poolisiin daqiiqaa 30 keessatti shakkamaa kana to'annaa jala oolchuu danda'eera. Qarshichi hundi yakka booda battalumaan deebifameera.

title: Declassified documents show UK aware of Israeli war crimes for 24 years
english: Newly released British government documents reveal that UK officials were aware of systematic human rights abuses by Israeli forces as early as 2002. Despite these internal warnings describing the military's actions as undisciplined and brutal, the British government continued to supply arms to Israel for over two decades. The files highlight a long-standing awareness of these violations, contrasting sharply with recent shifts in official British rhetoric regarding the conflict.
amharic: በቅርቡ ይፋ የተደረጉ የብሪታንያ የመንግስት ሰነዶች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ የዩኬ ዲፕሎማቶች እስራኤል በዌስት ባንክ የፈጸመቻቸውን የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶች ከ2002 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ ያውቁ ነበር። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ጨካኝ እና ዲሲፕሊን የሌላቸው መሆናቸውን በውስጥ ዘገባዎች ቢገልጹም፣ ብሪታንያ ለሁለት አስርት ዓመታት ያህል ለሀገሪቱ የጦር መሳሪያ ማቅረቧን ቀጥላለች። ይህ መረጃ የብሪታንያ መንግስት ስለ እስራኤል ድርጊት ለረጅም ጊዜ ግንዛቤ እንደነበረው የሚያረጋግጥ ነው።
oromo: Sanado mootummaa Breetaanii dhiheenya ifa ta'an akka agarsiisanitti, qondaaltonni Breetaanii humnoonni Israa'el bara 2002 irraa jalqabee sarbama mirga namoomaa raawwachaa turuu beekuu turan. Gochi waraana Israa'el kan adaba hin qabne fi hamaa ta'uu gabaasni keessoo ibsu illee, mootummaan Breetaanii waggoota digdamii oliif meeshaa waraanaa Israa'eliif dhiheessaa tureera. Sanadoonni kun mootummaan Breetaanii gocha Israa'el irratti hubannoo gahaa qabaachuu isaa kan mirkaneessan dha.

title: Saudi Arabia says drones launched from Iraq hit East-West Pipeline, holds off on retaliation
english: Saudi Arabia reported that drone attacks originating from Iraq struck its East-West oil pipeline. Despite this aggression, the kingdom has decided to pause any retaliatory actions at the request of the Iraqi prime minister. However, Saudi officials emphasized that they maintain the right to defend their national security and infrastructure if necessary.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ ከኢራቅ በተነሱ ድሮኖች የምስራቅ-ምዕራብ የነዳጅ ቧንቧ መስመሯ ጥቃት እንደደረሰበት አስታውቃለች። ምንም እንኳን ጥቃቱ ቢደርስም፣ የኢራቅ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ባቀረቡት ጥያቄ መሰረት ሳውዲ አረቢያ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ ከመውሰድ ተቆጥባለች። ይሁን እንጂ ሀገሪቱ የሉዓላዊነቷን እና የደህንነቷን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ አስፈላጊ ሆኖ ሲገኝ እርምጃ የመውሰድ መብቷ የተጠበቀ መሆኑን አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan sarara boba'aa bahaa-dhihaa ishee irra miidhaan kan gahe xiyyara nama hin feene (drones) Iraaq irraa ka'aniin akka ta'e ibsiteetti. Ta'us, gaaffii muummichi ministeera Iraaq dhiyeessaniin, mootummaan Saudii hanga ammaatti tarkaanfii haaloo bahuu irraa of qusateera. Kanaa wajjinis, biyyattiin nageenya fi mirga abbaa biyyummaa ishee kabachiisuuf jecha yeroo barbaachisaa ta'eetti tarkaanfii fudhachuuf mirga akka qabdu ibsiteetti.

title: Saudi Arabia says it closed vital East-West Pipeline after attack
english: Saudi Arabia has suspended operations on its critical East-West Pipeline following multiple attacks on Thursday that caused significant damage. While the perpetrators were not officially identified, the incident occurs amid heightening regional instability and Houthi military advances near the Red Sea. This closure creates further pressure on global oil markets, which were already struggling with rising prices due to regional conflict.

Haleellicha kan raawwate eenyu akka ta'e ifa baasu baatanis, ta'ichi kan uumame waraana naannichaa fi guddina humna Huutii waliin wal-qabata. Cufamuun booyyee kanaa gatiin boba'aa addunyaa irratti akka olka'uufi dhiibbaa diinagdee cimaa akka uumu sodaatameera.

title: Turkey's foreign minister discusses attacks on Saudi Arabia with Saudi counterpart, source says
english: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan recently held a phone conversation with his Saudi counterpart, Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud. The two leaders reviewed regional stability and addressed recent security threats faced by Saudi Arabia. This discussion follows a recent defense cooperation agreement signed between Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan.
amharic: የቱርክ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሃካን ፊዳን ከሳውዲ አቻቸው ልዑል ፋይሰል ቢን ፋርሃን አል ሳውድ ጋር በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። መሪዎቹ ስለ ቀጠናው ሁኔታ እና በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ ስለተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች መክረዋል። ይህ ውይይት የተካሄደው ቱርክ ከሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ከፓኪስታን ጋር የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ከተፈራረሙ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Turkii Haakan Fidaan, ministira dhimmi alaa Saudii Amiir Faysal biin Farhaan Al Saud waliin bilbilan mari’ataniiru. Hoggantoonni kunneen haala naannichaa fi weerara dhiheenya kana Saudi Arabiyaa irratti raawwatame irratti mari’ataniiru. Mariin kunis biyyoonni kunneen, jechuunis Turkii, Saudii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan walii-galtee ittisa biyyaa erga mallatteessanii booda kan ta’e dha.

title: Israel will not give Greece the source code for air-defence system: Report
english: Israel has decided not to share the primary source code for a $3.5 billion air-defense system it is building for Greece. While Greece will not have control over the core Israeli software, the Israeli defense ministry plans to help Athens develop a secondary, independent code that will allow Greek operators to manage their own system requirements. This situation highlights the common practice where nations retain technological control over advanced military exports to maintain a strategic advantage.
amharic: እስራኤል ለግሪክ በምትገነባው የ3.5 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የአየር መከላከያ ሥርዓት ላይ ዋናውን የኮምፒውተር ፕሮግራም ኮድ (source code) እንደማትሰጥ አስታውቃለች። ግሪክ የዋናውን ሥርዓት ሙሉ ቁጥጥር ባታገኝም፣ እስራኤል ለግሪክ የራሷን የውስጥ ኮድ እንድታዘጋጅ በመርዳት የሀገሪቱን የመከላከያ ፍላጎቶች በራሷ እንድትፈታ እንደምትደግፍ ገልጻለች። ይህ አካሄድ ሀገራት ለሌሎች ሲሸጡ ከፍተኛ የቴክኖሎጂ ቁጥጥርን የመጠበቅ ልምዳቸውን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el sirna ittisa qilleensaa gurguddaa kan biyyattii Giriikiif dollarri biliyoona 3.5 itti bahee ijaaramaa jiru irratti, koodii sirnicha to'atu (source code) Giriikiif akka hin kennine beeksisiteerti. Giriik to'annoo koodii ijoo Israa'el haala hin qabaanneef malee, mootummaan Israa'el Giriikiin koodii adda ta'e kan mataa ishee akka qabaattuuf gargaarsa akka gootu beekameera. Adeemsi kun biyyoonni meeshaalee waraanaa ammayyaa ergan yeroo hunda koodii fi tooftaa teeknoolojii isaanii of harkatti qabachuu akka barbaadan kan agarsiisuudha.

title: No military solution to conflict in Yemen, Eritrean foreign minister says
english: Eritrea's Foreign Minister Osman Saleh stated that the conflict in Yemen cannot be resolved through military force, emphasizing that external powers will not succeed in controlling the country. He noted that Yemen lacks a unified government, which complicates regional security efforts and the management of maritime routes in the Red Sea. Ultimately, he argued that Yemen must be allowed to achieve peace through non-military means.

oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Eertiraa Osman Saaleh, rakkoon Yemen waraanaan furamuu akka hin dandeenyeefi humnoonni alaa ummata Yemen injifachuu akka hin dandeenye dubbataniiru. Yemen keessatti mootummaan tokko ta'e waan hin jirreef, nageenya naannichaa fi nageenya daandii galaana Diimaa eeguun ulfaataa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Kanaafuu, Yemen nagaa argachuuf karaa waraana hin taaneen furmaata barbaaduu akka qabdu dhaamaniiru.

title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
english: The Houthi rebels in Yemen have significantly expanded their territorial control by seizing the strategic Perim Island and the port of Mokha. This military advance strengthens their influence over the vital Bab al-Mandab Strait, a crucial global shipping route. While the Houthis claim that international maritime travel remains safe, they continue to threaten Saudi Arabian vessels, prompting Saudi leadership to seek US military intervention.

title: Norway's Princess Astrid dies two days after attending brother King Harald's funeral
english: Princess Astrid of Norway has passed away at the age of 94, just two days after attending the funeral of her brother, the late King Harald V. As the last surviving child of King Olav V, she previously served as the nation's first lady for over a decade. The Norwegian government has announced that she will receive a state funeral, with flags across the country lowered to honor her life and service.

oromo: 公主阿斯特丽德 (Princess Astrid) 逝世，享年94岁。在此前两天，她刚刚参加了其兄长哈拉尔五世国王的葬礼。作为奥拉夫五世国王最后一位在世的子女，她曾担任挪威第一夫人长达十多年。挪威政府宣布将为其举行国葬，全国降半旗以示哀悼。

title: US declares end of largest recorded cyclosporiasis outbreak
english: US health authorities have officially ended the investigation into the country’s biggest cyclosporiasis outbreak, which was caused by contaminated iceberg lettuce from Mexico. The incident resulted in nearly 13,000 illnesses, 570 hospitalizations, and two tragic deaths across 21 states. Officials confirmed that the tainted products have been successfully removed from store shelves and restaurant supply chains.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የጤና ባለስልጣናት በሜክሲኮ በተመረተ የተበከለ የአይስበርግ ሰላጣ ሳቢያ ተከስቶ የነበረው ትልቁ የሳይክሎስፖሪያሲስ ወረርሽኝ ማብቃቱን ይፋ አድርገዋል። ይህ ወረርሽኝ በ21 ግዛቶች ውስጥ ወደ 13,000 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን በማሳመም፣ 570 ሰዎችን ለሆስፒታል በመዳረግ እና የሁለት ሰዎችን ህይወት ቀጥፏል። ችግር ያለባቸው ምርቶች ከገበያ እና ከምግብ ቤቶች ሙሉ ለሙሉ መወገዳቸውን ባለስልጣናቱ አረጋግጠዋል።

Dhibeen kun namoota 13,000 gahuu, namoota 570 hospitaala galchuufi lubbuu namoota lamaa kan galaafate yoo tahu, namoonni miidhaan irra gahe kunneenis aanaalee 21 keessa kan jiraatanidha. Qorannoo booda, salaanni faayale kun gabaa fi bakkeewwan nyaataa irraa guutummaatti akka kaafame mirkanaa'eera.

title: UK lawmakers vote against bill to legalise assisted dying
english: The UK House of Commons has rejected a proposed bill that would have allowed terminally ill adults in England and Wales to seek assisted dying. The legislation was defeated by a narrow margin of 286 to 270 votes after lawmakers were given a free vote based on their personal conscience. While advocates expressed significant disappointment, the failure of this measure means the issue cannot be revisited during the current parliamentary session.
