oromo: Mana maree bakka bu'oota uummataa UK keessatti, namoonni dhukkuba cimaan qabaman fedhii isaaniitiin lubbuu isaanii akka dabarsan kan hayyamu seera dhiyaatee ture sagalee caalmaan kufuu isaatu beekame. Miseensonni mana maree kun dhimma kana irratti ilaalcha mataa isaanii irratti hundaa'uun sagalee kan kennan yoo ta'u, seerni kun sagalee 286n mormamee 270n deggerame. Akkaataa kanaan seerni kun ragga'uu hin dandeenye yoo ta'u, murteen kun guddina guddaa kan ta'eef deggertoonni seera kanaa abdii kutachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Rising petrol costs drive sharp inflation increase in US in August
english: Consumer prices in the United States rose significantly in August, largely due to a sharp increase in petrol costs linked to rising global oil prices and geopolitical tensions. This monthly price hike was the largest seen in four months, pushing annual inflation to 3.4 percent. As fuel and other goods become more expensive, there is growing anticipation that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates soon.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የነዳጅ ዋጋ መጨመር እና በዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ገበያ ላይ ያለው የጂኦፖለቲካዊ ውጥረት የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲንር በማድረጉ የኦገስት ወር የዋጋ ግሽበት እንዲጨምር አድርጓል። ይህ የዋጋ ጭማሪ በአራት ወራት ውስጥ ከፍተኛው ሲሆን ዓመታዊ የዋጋ ግሽበቱንም 3.4 በመቶ ላይ አድርሶታል። የነዳጅና የሌሎች ምርቶች ዋጋ መናር የፌዴራል ሪዘርቭ የወለድ ምጣኔን ይጨምራል የሚል ግምት እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል።
oromo: Amerikaa keessatti gatiin boba'aa dabaluu fi rakkoon siyaasaa biyyoota alaa gatii boba'aa addunyaa ol kaasuu isaatiin, ji'a Hagayyaa keessa gatiin meeshaalee gurguddoo dabalee jira. Daballiin gatii kun ji'oota afur keessatti isa olaanaa yoo ta'u, gatiin meeshaalee waggaa keessatti gara dhibbeentaa 3.4tti ol guddateera. Daballiin gatii boba'aa fi meeshaalee biroo kun, Baankii Federaalaa (Federal Reserve) dhala baankii akka dabaluuf yaada jiruuf sababa ta'eera.

title: ‘Handcuffed and blindfolded’: Is the US targeting Ecuadorian fishermen?
english: Ecuadorian fishermen are accusing the United States military of attacking and destroying their boats during aggressive anti-drug operations in the Pacific Ocean. Many crew members report being detained, handcuffed, and blindfolded by US soldiers despite claiming they were only engaged in legal fishing activities. While the US military denies these specific allegations, reports suggest that maritime strikes have increased significantly under President Trump's administration.
amharic: የኢኳዶር አሳ አጥማጆች በአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ኃይሎች በፓስፊክ ውቅያኖስ ላይ በሚያደርጉት ጥብቅ የዕፅ አዘዋዋሪዎች ቁጥጥር ወቅት ጀልባዎቻቸው እየጠቁ እንደሆነ ይናገራሉ። አሳ አጥማጆቹ ህጋዊ የዓሣ ማጥመድ ሥራ ላይ ሳሉ በአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ታስረው እንደተደበደቡና ታፍነው እንደተወሰዱ ይገልጻሉ። የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ አመራር ክሱን ቢክድም፣ በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ስር በአሳ አጥማጅ ጀልባዎች ላይ የሚወሰዱ ጥቃቶች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመራቸው ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Qulqulleeyyonni qurxummii kan Ekuwadoor humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa hojii farra gurgurtaa qoricha sammua namaa cabsuu jedhaniin ganda isaanii irratti miidhaa geessisaa jiru jechuun himatu. Qulqulleeyyonni kunneen hojii qurxummii seera qabeessa ta'e irratti osoo jiranii, waraanni Ameerikaa akka isaan hidhee fi ija isaanirraa duucha jedhu. Waraanni Ameerikaa himannaa kana kan haalu ta'us, bulchiinsa Preezdaant Traamp jalatti weerarri markaba qulqulleeyyii qurxummii irratti gaggeeffamu dabalaa dhufeera.

title: Morocco PM takes aim at federation chief over 2030 World Cup final boast
english: Moroccan Prime Minister Aziz Akhannouch has criticized the head of the national football federation, Fouzi Lekjaa, for prematurely claiming that Morocco will host the 2030 World Cup final. The Prime Minister emphasized that such a major decision requires coordination with co-hosts Spain and Portugal and has not yet been confirmed by FIFA. Akhannouch warned against using the tournament as a political tool for election campaigns, urging officials to show diplomatic respect to their partners.
amharic: የሞሮኮ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አዚዝ አክሃኑሽ የሀገሪቱ የእግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን ፕሬዝዳንት ፉዚ ሌክጃ የ2030 የዓለም ዋንጫ ፍጻሜ በሞሮኮ እንደሚካሄድ አስቀድመው በመናገራቸው ተችተዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ እንደዚህ አይነት ትልቅ ውሳኔ ከጋራ አዘጋጆች ስፔን እና ፖርቱጋል ጋር መመካከርን የሚጠይቅ መሆኑን እና ፊፋም እስካሁን ይፋዊ ውሳኔ እንዳልሰጠ ገልጸዋል። የውድድሩን አስተናጋጅነት ለምርጫ ቅስቀሳ መጠቀሚያ ማድረግ እንደማይገባ በማስጠንቀቅ፣ ለባልደረባ ሀገራት ተገቢውን ክብር መስጠት እንደሚያስፈልግ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa biyya Marookoo Aziiz Akhaanush, hoogganaan federeeshinii kubbaa miilaa biyyattii Fuuzii Lekjaa, xumura waancaa addunyaa kan bara 2030 Marookoo keessatti akka gaggeeffamu dursanii dubbachuusaanii balaaleffataniiru. Mummichi ministeerichaa akka jedhanitti, murteen gurguddaan akkasii biyyoota waliin qopheessitoota ta'an Ispeenfi Poorchugaal wajjin mari'atamuu akka qabuufi FIFA'n hanga ammaa murtoo hin kennine ibsaniiru. Dhimma waancaa addunyaa kana duula filannoof akka meeshaatti fayyadamuu akka hin qabne akeekkachiisanii, biyyoota waliin hojjetanuf kabaja kennuun akka barbaachisu dhaamaniiru.

title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
english: The Israeli military has demolished a significant underground Hezbollah complex in southern Lebanon by detonating over 1,000 tonnes of explosives. This massive operation destroyed two tunnels spanning two kilometers, triggering tremors that were felt in surrounding cities and caused panic among local residents. The site served as a strategic hub for Hezbollah, housing weapons and command centers that the IDF claims were established with Iranian support over the past twenty years.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የሚገኝ የሂዝቦላህን ዋነኛ የመሬት ውስጥ መሠረተ ልማት ከ1,000 ቶን በላይ ፈንጂዎችን በመጠቀም አውድሟል። ይህ ግዙፍ ጥቃት ከሁለት ኪሎ ሜትር በላይ የሚረዝሙ ዋሻዎችን ያወደመ ሲሆን፣ በግዛቱ ላይ 4.1 የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ መጠን ያለው ንዝረት በመፍጠሩ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ድንጋጤን ፈጥሯል። እስራኤል ይህ ስፍራ ላለፉት ሁለት አስርት ዓመታት በኢራን ድጋፍ የተገነባ የጦር መሳሪያ ማከማቻና የትዕዛዝ ማዕከል እንደነበር አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el buufata gurguddaa garee Hizbullaah kan lafa jalaatti argamu, mi'a polopileeshiniifi dhuka'aa toonii 1,000 ol ta'uun barbadeesseera. Haleellaa kanaanis daandii lafa jalaa kilomeetira lama dheeratu kan barbadeesse yoo ta'u, kunis sochiin lafaa (earthquake) hanga 4.1 ga'u akka uumamu taasiseera. Israa'el buufanni kun waggoota 20 darban keessa deeggarsa Iraaniin kan ijaarame ta'uu ibsuun, iddoo meeshaalee waraanaa fi lafa itti ajajaa turan akka ta'e himteetti.

title: Ebola case detected in seventh DR Congo province
english: A new Ebola case has been confirmed in the South-Ubangi province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking the seventh province affected by the current outbreak. The patient, who tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain, reportedly contracted the virus while traveling through other regions before moving to South-Ubangi. This outbreak is currently the largest and deadliest in the nation's history, with health officials warning that the disease remains difficult to contain.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ወደ ሰባተኛው ግዛት ማለትም ወደ ደቡብ ኡባንጊ መድረሱ ተረጋግጧል። በቫይረሱ የተያዘው ሰው በሌሎች አካባቢዎች ከተዘዋወረ በኋላ በምርመራ የቡንዲቡግዮ ዝርያ እንዳለበት ታውቋል። ይህ ወረርሽኝ በሀገሪቱ ታሪክ እጅግ አደገኛ እና አብዛኞቹን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሆኖ ሳለ፣ የጤና ባለሙያዎች በሽታውን ለመቆጣጠር ፈታኝ እንደሆነ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Vaayrasii Ibolaa namatti argamuun isaa kan mirkanaa'e naannoo Kibba-Ubaangii kan mootummaa Dimokraatawaa Koongoo keessatti yoo ta'u, kunis naannoo torbaffa dhibee kanaan miidhame dha. Namichi vaayrasii kana qabu kun adeemsa isaa keessatti naannolee biroo keessa darbuun isaa kan ibsame yoo ta'u, qorannoon isaa akaakuu 'Bundibugyo' jedhamuun qabamuu isaa mirkaneesseera. Dhibeen kun seenaa biyyattii keessatti baay'ina du'aatiin kan isa duraa caaluu fi to'achuuf rakkisaa ta'uu ogeeyyonni fayyaa ibsaniiru.

title: Hull City’s Sorba Thomas unharmed as car overturned in crash
english: Hull City winger Sorba Thomas was involved in a car accident near the team's training facility in Cottingham. Although his vehicle flipped over and left the scene with significant damage, the club confirmed that the player was not injured. Thomas, who recently joined the team, is safe and unharmed following the incident.
amharic: የሃል ሲቲው አጥቂ ሶርባ ቶማስ በኮቲንግሃም በሚገኘው የክለቡ ልምምድ ማዕከል አቅራቢያ በደረሰ የመኪና አደጋ ውስጥ ገብቶ ነበር። ምንም እንኳን መኪናው ተገልብጦ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ቢደርስበትም፣ ተጫዋቹ ምንም አይነት ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰበት ክለቡ አረጋግጧል። በቅርቡ ወደ ቡድኑ የተቀላቀለው ቶማስ ከአደጋው በሰላም መትረፉን ተገልጿል።
oromo: Taphataan garee Hull City Sorba Thomas bakka leenjii garee isaanii kan Cottingham jedhamu biratti balaa konkolaataa mudateera. Konkolaataan isaa kan garagalee miidhaan guddaan irra ga'e ta'us, gareen isaa taphataan kun miidhaa tokko illee akka hin qaqqabne mirkaneesseera. Sorba Thomas yeroo dhihoo as garee kanaatti kan makame yoo ta'u, balaa kana booda fayyaa ta'uun isaa ibsameera.

title: ‘Majority do not welcome him’: Trump heads to Ireland amid fury over Gaza
english: Donald Trump is facing significant public backlash as he arrives in Ireland for a diplomatic visit. A large majority of the Irish population opposes his trip due to his administration's support for Israel’s actions in Gaza. Activists and students are organizing large-scale protests, while government officials remain cautious about the visit amidst these tensions.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ወደ አየርላንድ ሲያመሩ ከፍተኛ የህዝብ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። አብዛኛው የአየርላንድ ህዝብ ትራምፕ በጋዛ ጉዳይ ለእስራኤል ያላቸውን ድጋፍ በመቃወም ጉብኝታቸውን አይቀበልም። ተማሪዎች እና አክቲቪስቶች ትልቅ ሰልፍ እያዘጋጁ ሲሆን፣ የአየርላንድ ባለስልጣናትም በዚህ ውጥረት ውስጥ ጉብኝቱን ለመከታተል ተገድደዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump gara biyya Ayirlaandi yemmuu deemu mormii guddaa uummataa isa mudachaa jira. Uummata Ayirlaandi keessaa kan baay'een isaanii, tarkaanfii mootummaan Israa'el Gaza keessatti fudhatuuf deeggarsa inni godhu mormuun, daawwannaa isaa kana hin simatan. Barattoonni fi aktiivistoonni mormii guddaa qopheessaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, hoogganoonni biyyattis yaaddoo daawwannaa kanaa irratti argamu.

title: Why Pakistan is talking to Iran as the Houthi-Saudi fight escalates
english: Pakistan is actively engaging in diplomatic talks with Iran following a sharp escalation in the conflict between Saudi Arabia and Houthi forces. With Houthi militants seizing key coastal areas in Yemen, global oil prices have spiked due to fears over blocked trade routes. While Pakistan maintains a mutual defense pact with Saudi Arabia, it is currently prioritizing diplomatic outreach to Iran to manage the regional instability.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መካከል ያለው ግጭት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ፓኪስታን ከኢራን ጋር የዲፕሎማሲ ንግግሮችን እያደረገች ነው። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን የባህር ጠረፍ አካባቢዎችን በመቆጣጠራቸው የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መስመሮች ይዘጋሉ የሚል ስጋት በመፈጠሩ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጨምሯል። ፓኪስታን ከሳውዲ አረቢያ ጋር የመከላከያ ስምምነት ቢኖራትም፣ አሁን ባለው ሁኔታ ቀጠናዊ አለመረጋጋትን ለመቀነስ ከኢራን ጋር በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ለመስራት ትኩረት ሰጥታለች።
oromo: Waraanni gidduu Saudii Arabiyaa fi garee Huutii gidduutti taasifamu daran hammaachaa waan dhufeef, Paakistaan biyya Iraan waliin marii dippilomaasii gochaa jirti. Gareen Huutii qarqara galaana Yaman to'annoo isaa jala galchuun isaa, daandiiwwan daldala boba'aa ni cufamu soda jedhuun gatiin boba'aa addunyaa irratti akka ol ka'u taasiseera. Paakistaan waliigaltee ittisaa Saudii Arabiyaa waliin qabaattus, yeroo ammaa kana tasgabbii naannichaa eeguuf jecha marii dippilomaasii Iraan waliin taasiisuuf dursaa jirti.

title: The vanishing pharmacy of the Sundarbans
english: In the Sundarbans mangrove forest of Bangladesh, rising sea levels and salt intrusion are causing traditional medicinal plants to disappear. Local healers known as kabiraj are struggling to find the natural ingredients they have relied on for generations to treat community illnesses. As the environment degrades due to climate change, this unique, nature-based healthcare system is at risk of being lost forever.
amharic: በባንግላዴሽ በሚገኘው የሰንዳርባንስ ማንግሩቭ ደን ውስጥ እየጨመረ የመጣው የባህር ከፍታ እና የጨው መጠን ባህላዊ የመድኃኒት ተክሎች እንዲጠፉ እያደረገ ነው። ካቢራጅ በመባል የሚታወቁት የሀገር በቀል ፈዋሾች ለትውልድ ሲጠቀሙባቸው የነበሩትን የተፈጥሮ መድኃኒቶች ማግኘት እየተቸገሩ ነው። የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ አካባቢውን እየጎዳ በመምጣቱ፣ ይህ በደን ላይ የተመሠረተ የጤና አጠባበቅ ሥርዓት ሙሉ በሙሉ የመጥፋት አደጋ ተጋርጦበታል።
oromo: Bosona maangroovii Sundarbans kan Baangilaadeshi keessatti sadarkaan galaanaafi soogidda dabalaa dhufuun isaa biqiloota qorichaa aadaa mancaasaa jira. Ogeeyyonni fayyaa aadaa kan kabiraaj jedhaman, qoricha dhalootarraa dhalootatti tajaajilaa ture argachuuf rakkachaa jiru. Jijjiiramni qilleensaa naannichaa miidhaa waan jiruuf, sirni fayyaa uumama irratti hundaa'e kun guutummaatti baduuf qarqara jira.

title: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
english: The AI company Anthropic recently prevented individuals from using its technology to assist in the creation of dangerous biological weapons. Their new report details various malicious activities, including cyber espionage, propaganda campaigns, and online fraud, that they have successfully blocked. While industry leaders and politicians debate the future of AI safety, companies are increasing their efforts to identify and stop the misuse of their models.
amharic: አንትሮፒክ የተባለው የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ኩባንያ ግለሰቦች ቴክኖሎጂውን በመጠቀም አደገኛ የባዮሎጂካል መሳሪያዎችን ለማምረት ያደረጉትን ሙከራ ማክሸፉን አስታውቋል። ኩባንያው ባወጣው አዲስ ሪፖርት መሰረት፣ የሳይበር ጥቃቶችን፣ የፕሮፓጋንዳ ስራዎችን እና የማጭበርበር ተግባራትን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ የቴክኖሎጂ አላግባብ አጠቃቀሞችን መቆጣጠሩን ገልጿል። በዓለማችን የAI ቴክኖሎጂ ደህንነት ላይ ከፍተኛ ክርክር እየተደረገ ባለበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ የቴክኖሎጂ ድርጅቶች የራሳቸውን ሞዴሎች አላግባብ መጠቀምን ለመከላከል ጥረታቸውን አጠናክረዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni teeknooloojii Anthropic jedhamu, namoonni meeshaalee waraanaa baayoloojii balaa geessisuu danda'an hojjechuuf teeknooloojii isaa fayyadamuuf yaalii taasisan akka fashaleesse beeksiseera. Gabaasni haaraa isaanii, qindoomina cyber, duula propagandaa fi gowwoomsaawwan garaagaraa teeknooloojii isaanii fayyadamuun raawwatamaa turan akka dhaabsisaniif ibseera. Yeroo ammaa mootummoonniifi abbootiin qabeenyaa teeknooloojii AI irratti waldhabdee guddaa keessa jirutti, dhaabbileen teeknooloojii gochaalee hamoo ittisuuf carraaqqii cimaa taasisaa jiru.

title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists sentenced to up to seven years in prison
english: Three Hong Kong activists have received prison sentences ranging from five to over seven years for organizing annual vigils to remember the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. The court convicted them of inciting subversion against the state under the city's strict national security law. These commemorations were once common in Hong Kong but were banned by authorities following the implementation of the new legislation.
amharic: ሶስት የሆንግ ኮንግ አክቲቪስቶች እ.ኤ.አ በ1989 በቲያንመን አደባባይ የተፈፀመውን ጭፍጨፋ ለማስታወስ አመታዊ ሰልፎችን በማደራጀታቸው ከአምስት እስከ ሰባት ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ በከተማዋ ጥብቅ በሆነው የሀገር ውስጥ ደህንነት ህግ መሰረት መንግስትን ለመገልበጥ በማነሳሳት ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ብሏቸዋል። እነዚህ መታሰቢያዎች ቀደም ሲል በሆንግ ኮንግ ይካሄዱ የነበሩ ቢሆንም፣ አዲሱ ህግ ከወጣ በኋላ በመንግስት ታግደዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mirga namoomaa Hong Kong sadii, yaadannoo ajjeechaa bara 1989 isquare Tiananmen irratti raawwatame gaggeessaa waan turaniif hidhaa waggaa shan hanga torbaatti itti murameera. Manni murtichaa seera nageenya biyyoolessaa biyyattii cabsuun mootummaan akka gadi bu'u kakaasaniiru jechuun irratti murteesse. Yaadannoon kun dur Hong Kong keessatti kan gaggeeffamaa ture ta'us, seera haaraa bahe kanaan booda mootummaan dhoorkameera.

title: Five dead and dozens injured in coach crash in Swiss Alps
english: A tourist bus carrying Dutch nationals crashed and overturned in the Swiss Alps, resulting in five deaths. Dozens of passengers sustained various injuries and were transported to local hospitals by emergency crews and helicopters. Authorities have launched an investigation to determine the exact cause of the accident, which occurred near the town of Zernez.
amharic: በስዊዘርላንድ አልፕስ ተራሮች የቱሪስት አውቶቡስ ገልባጭ አደጋ በመድረሱ አምስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በጉዞው ላይ የነበሩ ደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ የኔዘርላንድ ዜጎች ለተለያዩ ጉዳቶች በመዳረጋቸው በአምቡላንስ እና በሄሊኮፕተር ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል። ባለሥልጣናት አደጋው በአካባቢው የደረሰበትን ትክክለኛ ምክንያት ለማወቅ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Alps Siwiizerlaanditti konkolaataan tajaajila tuuristii fe'ee deemu tokko garagaluun namoota shan ajjeeseera. Namoonni hedduun miidhaan irra ga'e kunis yeroo ammaa hospitaala geeffamanii yaalamaa jiru. Poolisiin naannichaa balaa kana ilaalchisee qorannoo eegaleera.

title: Buddhist monk arrested in suspected $3m embezzlement scandal
english: A prominent Thai Buddhist monk has been arrested for allegedly embezzling approximately $3 million in temple donations over a two-year period. Police discovered that money intended for monastery renovations and sacred amulets was diverted into private accounts, while a subsequent raid uncovered large amounts of gold and cash. The monk was defrocked after authorities found evidence of him breaking his vow of celibacy with a female accomplice, who was also taken into custody.
amharic: በታይላንድ ታዋቂ የሆነ አንድ የቡድሂስት መነኩሴ በሁለት ዓመት ጊዜ ውስጥ 3 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት የቤተ መቅደስ መዋጮ በመስረቅ ወንጀል ተጠርጥረው ተይዘዋል። ፖሊስ ለቤተ መቅደሱ እድሳት እና ለተቀደሱ የጸሎት ዕቃዎች የተሰበሰበው ገንዘብ ወደ ግል መለያቸው እንደገባ እና በቤታቸውም ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው ወርቅና ጥሬ ገንዘብ ማግኘቱን አስታውቋል። መነኩሴው ከሴት ተባባሪ ጋር ወሲብ ሲፈጽሙ የሚያሳይ ምስል መገኘቱን ተከትሎ ከሃይማኖታዊ ስልጣናቸው የተነሱ ሲሆን፣ ተባባሪዋም በቁጥጥር ስር ውላለች።
oromo: Mankuseen amantii Buddistii biyya Taayilaand keessatti bekamu tokko, waggoota lama keessatti qarshii miliyoona 3 ol ta'u kan kennaa mana amantichaa hattee argamee to'annoo jala ooleera. Poolisiin akka ibsetti, maallaqni mana amanticha suphuufi meeshaalee qulqulluu gurguruudhaan argame gara akkaawuntii dhuunfaa madaqfamee, maallaqniifi warqeen baay'eenis mana isaa keessatti argameera. Mankuseen kun kakuu isaa cabsee dubartii tokko waliin yeroo walqunnamtii saalaa raawwatu waan argameef, sadarkaa amantii isaa irraa ari'amee harki qabameera.

title: Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' goes up for auction
english: Princess Diana's famous 'revenge dress,' a custom black silk evening gown she wore in 1994, is set to be sold at a Sotheby's auction this December. The dress became iconic after she wore it to a public event shortly after Prince Charles admitted to adultery, effectively helping her regain control over her public image. Auction experts estimate the garment could reach a price of up to £220,000.
amharic: የልዕልት ዳያና ታዋቂው 'የበቀል ቀሚስ' በመባል የሚታወቀው ጥቁር የሐር ልብስ በታህሳስ ወር በሶተቢስ ጨረታ ሊሸጥ ነው። ልዕልት ዳያና ይህን ቀሚስ በ1994 የለበሱት ልዑል ቻርለስ የፍቅር ግንኙነት መፈጸማቸውን ከተናገሩ በኋላ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ድርጊታቸውም በህዝብ ዘንድ ትልቅ መነጋገሪያ ሆኖ ነበር። የጨረታ ባለሙያዎች ይህ ታሪካዊ ቀሚስ እስከ 220,000 ፓውንድ ሊሸጥ እንደሚችል ይጠብቃሉ።
oromo: Uffanni 'haaloo ba'uu' jedhamee beekamu kan illee Princess Diana bara 1994 uffatte, ji'a Muddeetti kiree ykn caalbaatii 'Sotheby's' irratti dhiyaachuuf jira. Uffanni kun kan beekame erga illee Charles hariiroo alaa qabaachuu isaa erga amanee booda, Diana ifatti mul'achuu isheetiin booda ture. Ogeeyyoonni caalbaatii kanaa uffanni seena-qabeessi kun hanga paawundii 220,000tti gurguramu danda'a jedhanii tilmaamu.

title: Republican midterm message: Democrats are the threat
english: During their midterm convention in Dallas, Republican speakers focused their campaign messaging on framing the Democratic Party as a significant danger to the United States. They used aggressive rhetoric to challenge national identity and leveraged international issues in the Middle East to gain political support. This strategy aims to characterize their opponents as extremists to influence voter sentiment ahead of the upcoming elections.
amharic: በዳላስ በተካሄደው የመሃል ዘመን ምርጫ ኮንፈረንስ ላይ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ተናጋሪዎች የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲን ለአሜሪካ ትልቅ ስጋት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። በንግግራቸውም የሀገርን ማንነት እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የሚከሰቱ ክስተቶችን በመጠቀም ተቃዋሚዎቻቸውን ጽንፈኛ እንደሆኑ አድርገው ለማሳየት ሞክረዋል። ይህ አካሄድ በምርጫው ወቅት መራጮችን ወደ ጎናቸው ለማዞር ያለመ የዘመቻ ስልት ነው።
oromo: Si'a kana walga'ii filannoo giddu galeessaatti, dubbattoonni paartii Ripaabilikaanii paartii Dimokiraatawii akka sodaafi balaa guddaa biyyattii ta'etti ibsaniiru. Namoonni kunneen eenyummaa biyyoolessaa fi rakkoolee naannoo Baha Giddu galeessaa fayyadamuun mormitoota isaanii akka hammaattootatti dhiyeessuun sagalee filattootaa argachuu yaalan. Duulli kun filannoo dhufu irratti mormitoota isaanii xureessuudhaan deeggarsa argachuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Al Jazeera explains massive Israeli blasts on south Lebanon hill
english: The Israeli military recently carried out a massive operation in southern Lebanon, detonating over 1,100 tonnes of explosives to destroy alleged Hezbollah tunnels. These explosions were powerful enough to register as a 4.1 magnitude tremor on the Ali al-Taher ridge. Israeli officials claim the move was intended to dismantle underground infrastructure belonging to the armed group.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የአሊ አል-ታሂር ኮረብታ ስር ይገኛሉ የተባሉ የሂዝቦላህ ዋሻዎችን ለማውደም ከ1,100 ቶን በላይ ፈንጂዎችን ተጠቅሟል። እነዚህ ፍንዳታዎች እጅግ ኃይለኛ ከመሆናቸው የተነሳ 4.1 ማግኒቱድ ያለው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ አስከትለዋል። እስራኤል ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደችው የቡድኑን የመሬት ውስጥ መዋቅር ለማፈራረስ እንደሆነ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el kibba Libnaanotti lafa Ali al-Taher jedhamu jala turan kan jedhaman hololoo garee Hizbollaah barbadeessuuf, meeshaa waraanaa kilo giraama kuma 1,100 ol ta'u itti fayyadameera. Dhoohiinsi kun cimaa waan ta'eef, lafti sun sochii 4.1 kan qabu akka raafamu godheera. Israa'el tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte, bu'uura misooma garee kanaa kan ta'e hololoo sana diiguuf akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: ‘Blew the hell out of it’: How Iran damaged US bases in Bahrain, Jordan
english: A senior US Navy official has publicly confirmed that Iranian retaliatory strikes caused severe damage to a major American naval base in Bahrain and air facilities in Jordan. The strikes, which occurred during the ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran, have severely impacted several buildings and aircraft. Consequently, the Pentagon is now conducting a formal assessment to determine whether these military installations can be repaired or if they should be abandoned.
amharic: ከፍተኛ የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ባለስልጣን ኢራን በወሰደችው የአጸፋ እርምጃ በባህሬን የሚገኘው የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ጣቢያ እና በዮርዳኖስ የሚገኙ የአየር ማረፊያዎች ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው አረጋግጠዋል። በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ባለው ግጭት ወቅት የተፈጸሙት እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በበርካታ ህንጻዎች እና አውሮፕላኖች ላይ ከፍተኛ ውድመት አስከትለዋል። በዚህም ሳቢያ፣ የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር የተጎዱት ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎች መጠገን አለባቸው ወይስ መሰረዝ አለባቸው የሚለውን ለመወሰን ጥናት እያደረገ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana galaanaa Amerikaa akka mirkaneessanitti, tarkaanfii deebii Iran fudhatteen buufata waraanaa Amerikaa kan Bahrain keessatti argamuufi buufataalee xiyyaaraa Yordaanoos jiran irratti miidhaan cimaan ga’eera. Waraana Amerikaa, Israa’eliifi Iran gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru kanaan buufataalee kana keessatti manneeniifi xiyyaarotni hedduun barbadaa’aniiru. Haaluma kanaan, Pentagoniin buufataaleen waraana kun suphamanii itti fufuu qabu moo dhiifamuu qabu irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jira.

title: Family members wait after deadly Philippines ferry fire
english: A passenger ferry in the Philippines caught fire, resulting in the tragic deaths of at least five people. Rescue operations are currently underway as many passengers remain unaccounted for. Distraught family members are gathered at the port in Manila, anxiously waiting for updates on the fate of their relatives.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ አንድ የሳፋሪ መርከብ ላይ በተነሳ ድንገተኛ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው ከደረሰ በኋላ በርካታ ተሳፋሪዎች የት እንደደረሱ ስላልታወቀ የነፍስ አድን ስራው ቀጥሏል። በከተማዋ ወደብ ላይ የተሰበሰቡ የሟቾች ቤተሰቦች ስለ ወዳጆቻቸው ሁኔታ መረጃ ለማግኘት በከፍተኛ ጭንቀት እየጠበቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Filippiinis keessatti markaba namoota fe'u tokko irratti ibidda ka'een lubbuun namoota shanii ol darbeera. Namoonni hedduun erga ibidda kana booda eessa akka ga'an waan hin beekamneef, hojiin barbaachaafi fayyisuu bal'inaan itti fufee jira. Maatiin miidhame kunis ganda Manilla keessatti argamuun, waa'ee jaallatamtoota isaanii oduu gaddisiisaa ta'e dhaga'uuf sodaa guddaa keessa taa'aa jiru.

title: Houthis take control of Yemen’s Red Sea coast and key shipping route
english: Houthi forces have successfully seized control of Yemen’s entire Red Sea coastline, including critical strategic points near the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. By taking over these coastal areas and nearby islands, the group now possesses significant influence over a vital maritime passage used for global oil shipments. This development marks a major shift in the conflict, potentially threatening international trade routes that serve as alternatives to the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የየመን ቀይ ባህር ጠረፍን ሙሉ በሙሉ መቆጣጠራቸውን ዘገባዎች አመልክተዋል። ቡድኑ በባብ አል-ማንደብ ባህር ዳርቻ እና በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ ደሴቶች ላይ ቁጥጥር በማድረጉ ለዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ ወሳኝ የሆነውን የባህር መስመር በእጃቸው አስገብተዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በክልሉ ያለውን ግጭት ከማባባሱም በላይ፣ አማራጭ የንግድ መስመሮችን አደጋ ላይ ሊጥል እንደሚችል ተሰግቷል።
oromo: Humni Houtii guutummaa qarqara galaana diimaa kan Yaman to'annoo isaanii jala galchuu gabaasni ni ibsa. Gareen kun qarqara galaana Bab al-Mandeb fi duun-galaanota naannichaa to'achuu isaaniitiin, karaa markabinni boba'aa itti darbu irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumuu danda'aniiru. Tarkaanfin kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa kan hammaachiisu ta'uun, karaa daldala idil-addunyaa kanneen biroo balaaf saaxiluu danda'a.

title: Five killed and 67 injured in Russian strike on shopping centre, Ukraine says
english: A Russian drone strike on a shopping center in the Ukrainian city of Pavlohrad has resulted in five deaths and 67 injuries, including several children. This daylight attack occurred during busy hours, causing significant damage to nearby shops and vehicles. While international efforts to broker peace continue, the ongoing conflict remains intense with both sides reporting further casualties from recent drone operations.
amharic: በዩክሬን ፓቭሎህራድ ከተማ በሚገኝ የገበያ ማዕከል ላይ በተፈጸመ የሩሲያ ድሮን ጥቃት አምስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ 67 የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ህዝብ በሚበዛበት የቀን ሰዓት በመሆኑ በገበያ ማዕከሉ እና በአቅራቢያው ባሉ ተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ሰላም ለማውረድ ጥረቶች እየተደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ የጦርነቱ መጠናከር በሁለቱም በኩል የሰዎች ህይወት መጥፋት እና ጉዳት እየቀጠለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humni Ruusiyaa magaalaa Paavloohiraad keessatti bakka gabaa tokko irratti xiyyaara malee to’atamuun yoo rukutu, namoota shan ajjeesee 67 immoo madeesseera. Miidhaan kun kan qaqqabe guyyaa bakki gabaa namaan guutamee jirutti ta’uun, suuqotaa fi konkolaattota hedduu irratti barbadaa’ina guddaa fideera. Mormiin biyyoota lamaan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru kun ittuma fufee waan jiruuf, lola kanaan miidhaan lubbuu fi qabeenyaa ittuma fufee jira.

title: Hundreds flee as fire destroys migrant shelters in Ceuta
english: A large fire broke out in the Spanish city of Ceuta, completely destroying numerous shelters housing migrants. Hundreds of individuals were forced to evacuate the area to escape the flames. Fortunately, officials confirmed that no injuries occurred, and an official investigation is now underway to determine if the fire was started intentionally.
amharic: በስፔን ሴኡታ ከተማ በተቀሰቀሰ ከባድ የእሳት አደጋ በርካታ የስደተኞች መጠለያዎች ሙሉ ለሙሉ ወድመዋል። እሳቱን በመሸሽ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተገደዋል። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እንዳልተመዘገበ ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ እሳቱ ሆን ተብሎ የተለኮሰ መሆን አለመሆኑን ለማወቅ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Se'uuta, Ispeen keessatti ibidda cimaa ka'een manni jireenyaa godaantotaa baay'een barbadaa'aniiru. Namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman ibidda kana jalaa lubbuu isaanii oolchuuf iddoo sana gadhiisanii baqataniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa miidhaan qaamaa ykn lubbuu namarra hin ga'in mirkaneessanii, ibiddi kun qorannoo booda akka beekamuuf akka tasaa ykn of eeggannoo dhabuudhaan ykn immoo namoota hamootiin kan qabsiifame ta'uu isaa qorannoon eegalameera.

title: How 9/11 conspiracy theories moved into mainstream American politics
english: Twenty-five years after the September 11 attacks, conspiracy theories regarding the event have shifted from fringe internet discussions into the center of American political discourse. Driven by a general decline in public trust and the rise of social media influencers, these false narratives are now frequently used by political figures to manipulate public sentiment. This trend reflects a broader pattern of misinformation that has also influenced movements like the January 6 Capitol riot and current geopolitical debates.
amharic: የሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ ሃያ አምስት ዓመታት በኋላ፣ ስለ ክስተቱ የሚናፈሱ የሴራ ትረካዎች ከኢንተርኔት ማህበራዊ መሰረቶች ወጥተው ወደ ዋናው የአሜሪካ ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ዘልቀው ገብተዋል። በህዝብ ዘንድ ያለው የመንግስት አመኔታ መቀነስ እና የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ተፅእኖ ፈጣሪዎች ሚና ለእነዚህ ሀሰተኛ መረጃዎች መስፋፋት ዋና ምክንያት ሆነዋል። ይህ አካሄድ ፖለቲከኞች የህዝብን ስሜት ለመቆጣጠር እና የየራሳቸውን የፖለቲካ አጀንዳ ለማራመድ የሚጠቀሙበት መሳሪያ ሆኗል።
oromo: Hujii shororkeessummaa Sadaasa 11 erga raawwatame waggaa digdamii shan booda, oduuwwan odeeffannoo sobaa ta'an kun daangaa intarneetii darbanii gara siyaasa guddicha Ameerikaa keessa seenaniiru. Hir'inni amantii ummataa fi qooda fudhannaan namoota miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti beekamtii qabanii, oduuwwan dhugaa irraa fagaatan kun akka babal'atan gargaareera. Haalli kun siyaasa keessatti jijjiirama dhufee, angawoonni siyaasaa miira ummataa to'achuuf fi fedhii isaanii guuttachuuf odeeffannoo sobaa akka meeshaatti akka fayyadaman taasiseera.

title: ‘Everything changed’: The human cost of 25 years of US wars
english: In the twenty-five years since the 9/11 attacks, United States military campaigns across various nations have resulted in the deaths of over 4.5 million people. These long-term conflicts, which began in Afghanistan and Iraq, have also caused the displacement of more than 38 million individuals. Beyond direct combat casualties, millions have perished due to secondary effects such as malnutrition, disease, and the long-term instability left behind by these wars.
amharic: ከሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት በኋላ ባሉት ሃያ አምስት ዓመታት ውስጥ፣ አሜሪካ በተለያዩ ሀገራት ባካሄደችው ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ከ4.5 ሚሊዮን በላይ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። በአፍጋኒስታን እና በኢራቅ የጀመሩት እነዚህ የረጅም ጊዜ ጦርነቶች ከ38 ሚሊዮን በላይ ሰዎች እንዲፈናቀሉ ምክንያት ሆነዋል። በቀጥታ ከጦርነት በተጨማሪ፣ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በረሃብ፣ በተለያዩ በሽታዎች እና ከጦርነቱ በኋላ ባለው አለመረጋጋት ምክንያት ለህልፈት ተዳርገዋል።
oromo: Hojii waraanaa Ameerikaan erga haleellaa Fulbaana 11 raawwatee as biyyoota adda addaa keessatti gaggeessiteen lubbuun namoota miliyoona 4.5 olii darbeera. Waraanni Afgaanistaanii fi Iraaq keessatti jalqabe kun namoota miliyoona 38 ol buqqaaseera. Miidhaa waraanaatiin ala, namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman hanqina nyaataa, dhukkubaa fi rakkoolee nageenyaa waraanni kun duubatti hambiseef jecha lubbuun isaanii darbeera.

title: NAZA, the Israeli film revealing new layers of the Gaza genocide
english: The Israeli film NAZA has gained significant international attention and received a lengthy standing ovation at the Biennale for its critical look at the conflict in Gaza. The creators acknowledge that being Israeli granted them unique access to document the situation, highlighting a disparity where Palestinian filmmakers often encounter obstacles when trying to share their own perspectives. This documentary aims to bring new visibility to the human impact of the war through a lens rarely seen from within Israel.
amharic: NAZA የተሰኘው የእስራኤል ፊልም በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት በመዳሰስ በቢኤናሌ የፊልም ፌስቲቫል ላይ ከፍተኛ አድናቆትን አትርፏል። ፊልም ሰሪዎቹ የእስራኤል ዜግነት መያዛቸው ሁኔታውን ለመዘገብ እድል እንደሰጣቸው በመጥቀስ፣ የፍልስጤም ፊልም ሰሪዎች ግን ታሪካቸውን ለመንገር መሰናክሎች እንደሚገጥሟቸው አስረድተዋል። ይህ ዘጋቢ ፊልም ከእስራኤል ውስጥ ሆኖ የጦርነቱን ተፅዕኖ በተለየ መንገድ ለማሳየት ይጥራል።
oromo: Fiilmiin Israa'el NAZA jedhamu, waraana Gaazaatti gaggeeffamaa jiru irratti xiyyeeffachuun isaa fiilmiiwwan biroo keessatti fudhatama guddaa argatee jira. Qopheessitoonni fiilmichaa lammii Israa'el ta'uun isaanii haala sana ibsuuf carraa addaa akka isaanif kenne himanii, gama biraatiin garuu filmii hojjattoonni Falasxiin seenaa isaanii himuuf gufuuwwan adda addaa akka isaan mudatu ibsaniiru. Fiilmiin kun miidhaa waraana sanaa ilaalcha Israa'el keessa jiruun mul'isuuf kan kaayyeffatedha.

title: Fenerbahce coach Kartal’s resignation refused as bottle thrown in Roma tie
english: Fenerbahce coach Ismail Kartal attempted to resign after being struck by a bottle thrown by a spectator during a Champions League match against Roma. Club president Aziz Yildirim rejected the resignation, insisting that Kartal remains in his position despite the coach's distress. The club has since identified and banned the individual responsible for the incident.
amharic: የፌነርባቼው አሰልጣኝ እስማኤል ካርታል ከሮማ ጋር በተደረገው የሻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ ወቅት በደጋፊዎች በተወረወረ ጠርሙስ ከተመቱ በኋላ ስራቸውን ለመልቀቅ ሞክረው ነበር። የክለቡ ፕሬዝዳንት አዚዝ ይልዲሪም የአሰልጣኙን የስራ መልቀቂያ ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ በስሜት ውስጥ ቢሆኑም በስራቸው እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል። ክለቡም ድርጊቱን የፈጸመውን ግለሰብ በመለየት ከስታዲየም ታግዷል።
oromo: Leenjisaan garee Fenerbahce Ismail Kartal, tapha Champions League Roma waliin ta'een irratti erga xalayaa bishaan qabu tokkoon rukutamee booda hojii gadhiisuuf yaalii godhee ture. Pirezidaantiin kilabichaa Aziz Yildirim gaaffii leenjisichaa diduun, miirri isaa miidhamee utuu jiruu bakka hojii isaatti akka itti fufu murteessaniiru. Kilabichi namicha kana adda baasuun dirree isaa irraa dhorkeera.

title: Araghchi welcomes US navy secretary’s Bahrain damage remarks
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi publicly acknowledged comments made by US Navy Secretary nominee Hung Cao regarding significant damage caused to a US base in Bahrain during past attacks. Araghchi praised Cao's honesty in confirming the effectiveness of Iran's military actions against American installations. Furthermore, he used the statement to criticize US involvement in regional conflicts, suggesting that the American public should not be funding such military operations.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ፣ በአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ሚኒስትር ዕጩ ሁንግ ካኦ የተነገሩትን አስተያየቶች በይፋ ተቀብለዋል። ካኦ ቀደም ሲል በባህሬን በሚገኘው የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ጣቢያ ላይ በደረሰው ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ዙሪያ የሰጡትን መግለጫ አራግቺ አድንቀዋል። ሚኒስትሩ ይህንን አጋጣሚ በመጠቀም የአሜሪካ መንግስት በክልሉ የሚያደርገውን ጣልቃ ገብነት በመተቸት አሜሪካውያን ለሌሎች አገራት ጦርነት ወጪ መሸከም እንደሌለባቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchi, mucucaannaa nama aangoo Ministira Humna Galaana Ameerikaatiif dhiyaate Hung Ka'oon buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Baahireyn keessa jiru irratti miidhaa gahe ilaalchisee dubbatan fudhatama kennaniiru. Araagchi, ibsa Ka'oon miidhaa gahe irratti kennan dhugaa dubbachuu akka ta'e ibsuun gocha waraana Iraan dinqisiifataniiru. Gama biraatiin, ministirichi ibsa kana fayyadamuun Ameerikaan dhimma naannichaa keessa galuu ishee balaaleffachuun, ummanni Ameerikaa baasii waraana biyyoota biraa kafaluu akka hin qabne dubbataniiru.

title: Araghchi discusses regional situation with Saudi, South Korean counterparts
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi recently held separate phone calls with the foreign ministers of Saudi Arabia and South Korea. These discussions focused on the growing instability and rising tensions across the Middle East. Both conversations emphasized the importance of maintaining diplomatic cooperation to de-escalate regional crises and ensure maritime security.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ ከሳዑዲ አረቢያ እና ከደቡብ ኮሪያ አቻዎቻቸው ጋር በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። ውይይቱ በዋናነት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጸጥታ ችግር እና አለመረጋጋት ላይ ያተኮረ ነበር። ሁለቱም ወገኖች ቀውሱን ለማርገብ እና የክልሉን ሰላም ለመጠበቅ የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቶችን ማጠናከር አስፈላጊ መሆኑን አስምረውበታል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbas Araagchi ministiroota dhimma alaa Sa'udii Arabiyaa fi Kooriyaa Kibbaa wajjin bilbilaan mari'ataniiru. Mariin isaanii kun rakkoo nageenyaa fi walitti bu'iinsa naannoo Baha Giddu-galeessaa keessatti dabalaa jiru irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture. Gamtaan lamaanuu, rakkoo kana tasgabbeessuu fi nageenya naannichaa eeguuf qindoominni dippiloomaasii murteessaa ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Iran dismisses IAEA resolution, says nonproliferation accusations political
english: Iran has rejected a recent IAEA resolution that accuses the country of violating nuclear nonproliferation agreements and refers the issue to the UN Security Council. Iranian officials claim the allegations are politically motivated rather than based on technical evidence. Tehran maintains that its nuclear activities are entirely peaceful and denies the claims made by Western nations.
amharic: ኢራን የአቶሚክ ኢነርጂ ዓለም አቀፍ ድርጅት (IAEA) ያወጣውን ውሳኔ ውድቅ አድርጋለች። ድርጅቱ ኢራን የኒውክሌር ስምምነቶችን ባለማክበር ለተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት እንድትጠየቅ ማድረጉን ኢራን ተቃውማለች። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ክሱ ቴክኒካዊ ሳይሆን የፖለቲካ ዓላማ ያለው ነው ሲሉ የሀገሪቱን የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራም ሰላማዊ መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Iraan murtee dhaabbata anniisaa niwukilaraa addunyaa (IAEA) kan isheen walii galtee niwukilaraa hin kabajne jechuun gara mana maree nageenyaa UN erge fudhatama dhabsiisteetti. Mootummaan Iraan himannaan kun qorannoo teeknikaa irratti kan hundaa'e osoo hin taane, kan siyaasaa akka ta'e ibsiteetti. Biyyattiin sagantaan niwukilaraa ishee guutummaatti nagaa qofaaf kan oolu ta'uu irra deebitee mirkaneessiteetti.

title: Under siege: Iran faces strategic dilemma as war of attrition drags on
english: Tensions between Iran and the U.S. have escalated following reciprocal military strikes, with Tehran targeting American bases after U.S. actions in the region. Iran is facing severe economic hardship, evidenced by a weakening currency and critical gasoline shortages exacerbated by limited support from a struggling Russia. These pressures have fueled a debate within the Iranian government over whether to continue absorbing these costs or to retaliate more aggressively against Washington and its allies.
amharic: ኢራን እና አሜሪካ እያደረጉት ባለው የጋራ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት የተነሳ በመካከላቸው ያለው ውጥረት እየተባባሰ መጥቷል። ኢራን በአሜሪካ ላይ ጥቃት የሰነዘረችው በክልሉ ውስጥ በደረሰብን ድብደባ ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ አሁን እየገጠማት ባለው የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስና የነዳጅ እጥረት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ፈተና ውስጥ ትገኛለች። በተለይም ከሩሲያ ያገኘችው ድጋፍ መቀነስ እና የገንዘብ ምንዛሪ መውረድ በመንግስት ውስጥ ስልታዊ ለውጥ እንዲደረግ ወይም አጸፋዊ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ ውይይቶችን ቀስቅሷል።
oromo: Iraanii fi Ameerikaan wal-ittii aansuun tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachaa jiruun walitti buutiinsii isaan gidduu jiru daran hammaachaa dhufeera. Iraan rakkoo diinagdee cimaa fi hanqina boba'aa keessa jirtu kan keessa darbaa jirtu yoo ta'u, kunis gargaarsi Raashiyaan ishee gargaaruu dhabuu fi gatiin maallaqa ishee gadi bu'uu irraan kan ka'e dha. Haalli kun mootummaan Iraan tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu ykn rakkoo kana akkamitti akka ofirraa ittisu irratti yaada adda addaa akka kaasu taasiseera.

title: Gulf foreign ministers plan to meet Araghchi in Oman, FT report says
english: Foreign ministers from Gulf Cooperation Council nations are planning a meeting with Iran's top diplomat, Abbas Araghchi, in Oman. This discussion aims to establish a temporary agreement to secure safe shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz. Iran is seeking regional support to pressure the U.S. into easing restrictions on its ports, while Gulf states are focused on maintaining stable maritime trade.
amharic: የባህረ ሰላጤው የትብብር ምክር ቤት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች ከኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ ጋር በኦማን ለመገናኘት አቅደዋል። የዚህ ውይይት ዋና ዓላማ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ሰላጤ በኩል የሚደረገውን የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ ጊዜያዊ በሆነ መንገድ ለማስተዳደር ስምምነት ላይ መድረስ ነው። ኢራን በአገሯ ወደቦች ላይ የተጣለውን እገዳ እንዲነሳ ለማድረግ የክልሉን ድጋፍ ስትፈልግ፣ የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት ደግሞ የመርከብ እንቅስቃሴ መስተጓጎል እንደሌለበት ማረጋገጥ ይፈልጋሉ።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa biyyoota Gulaa (GCC) ministira dhimma alaa Iraan Abbas Araagchi waliin Oomaanitti wal arguuf karoorfataniiru. Mariin kun karaa galaana Hormuz irratti geejjiba dooniiwwanii nagaan akka gaggeeffamu walii galtee yeroo gabaabaa uumuuf kan gargaaru dha. Iraan duula dooniiwwan ishee irratti godhame akka dhaabatuuf deeggarsa biyyoota ollaa gaafachaa jirti, biyyoonni Gulaa immoo daldalli galaana irraa akka hin gufanne mirkaneessuuf yaalii gochaa jiru.

title: Maduro’s wife seeks home detention as heart condition worsens in US custody
english: Cilia Flores, the former first lady of Venezuela, is requesting home detention in New York due to a significant decline in her heart health while in U.S. custody. Her legal team argues that the current detention facility cannot provide the specialized cardiac care and surgical procedures she urgently requires. Flores and her husband, Nicolas Maduro, are currently awaiting trial on drug and weapons charges following their removal from Venezuela by U.S. military forces.
amharic: የቀድሞው የቬንዙዌላ ቀዳማዊ እመቤት ሲሊያ ፍሎሬስ በአሜሪካ እስር ቤት እያሉ የልብ ህመማቸው እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ በኒውዮርክ በቤታቸው እንዲታሰሩ ጠይቀዋል። የህግ ባለሙያዎቻቸው እንዳሉት በአሁኑ ጊዜ የሚገኙበት ማረሚያ ቤት ለህመማቸው የሚያስፈልገውን የልብ ህክምና እና የቀዶ ጥገና አገልግሎት መስጠት አይችልም። ፍሎሬስ እና ባለቤታቸው ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ በአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን ከቬንዙዌላ ከተወሰዱ በኋላ በአደንዛዥ እፅ እና በጦር መሳሪያ ዝውውር ክስ የፍርድ ሂደት በመጠባበቅ ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Hawaan duraanii Venezuuela Siiliiyaa Foloores yeroo hidhaa Ameerikaa jiranitti dhibeen onnee isaanii waan itti hammaateef, Mana Murtii Niiw Yookitti mana isaanii akka tursiifaman gaafataniiru. Gareen abukaatoota isaanii akka ibsanitti, bakki amma hidhaa jiran kun yaala onnee fi baqaqsanii hodhuu hatattamaa isaaniif barbaachisu dhiyeessuuf hin danda'u. Foloores fi abbaan manaa isaanii Niikolaas Maaduuroo, waraanni Ameerikaa Venezuuela keessaa erga butee booda himannaa qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochu fi meeshaa waraanaa irratti baname eeggachaa jiru.

title: Why is Uber pulling out of some African markets?
english: Uber has officially exited the Nigerian and Ugandan markets after over a decade of operations, following previous departures from countries like Tanzania and Ivory Coast. The decision stems from the rising costs of fuel and vehicle maintenance, which have made it difficult to balance affordable passenger fares with fair driver earnings. These economic pressures, worsened by recent policy changes, led to significant protests from drivers who found it increasingly impossible to maintain a profitable business.
amharic: ኡበር ከናይጄሪያ እና ከኡጋንዳ ገበያዎች ከለቀቀ በኋላ፣ በአፍሪካ ውስጥ የነበረውን የአስር ዓመት አገልግሎቱን አቋርጧል። ኩባንያው ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰነው በነዳጅ ዋጋ መናር እና በተሽከርካሪ ጥገና ወጪዎች መጨመር ምክንያት፣ በተመጣጣኝ ዋጋ ለተሳፋሪዎች አገልግሎት መስጠት እና ለሾፌሮች ትርፋማ መሆን አስቸጋሪ በመሆኑ ነው። እነዚህ የኢኮኖሚ ጫናዎች እና የዋጋ ጭማሪዎች፣ በሾፌሮች ዘንድ ሰፊ ተቃውሞ እንዲፈጠር እና ንግዱን ዘላቂ እንዳይሆን አድርገውታል።
oromo: Uber erga waggaa kudhan oliif biyyoota Afrikaa keessatti tajaajila kennaa ture booda, gabaa Naayijeeriyaa fi Yugaandaa keessaa bahuuf murteesseera. Murtoon kun kan dhufe gatiin boba'aa fi kaffaltiin suphaa konkolaataa dabaluun isaa, gatii tajaajilaa xiqqeessuu fi galii ooftotaa madaaluu waan ulfaatesseefidha. Dhiibbaan dinagdee fi jijjiiramni siyaasaa biyyattii ooftotaa fi dhaabbaticha gidduutti wal dhabdee fi mormii guddaa waan uumeef, tajaajila isaanii itti fufsiisuun rakkisaa ta'eera.

title: Iran claims to have captured a US ‘sail drone’ near Hormuz Strait
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard reported seizing an American unmanned surface vessel near the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian officials alleged the craft was on an aggressive mission, though they provided few specific details. The United States government has not yet issued an official response regarding the incident.
amharic: የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ በሆርሙዝ ባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ የአሜሪካን ሰው አልባ የባህር ላይ መርከብ እንደያዙ አስታውቀዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት መርከቧ ጠበኝነት የተሞላበት ተልዕኮ ላይ ነበረች ሲሉ ቢከሱም፣ ተጨማሪ ዝርዝር መረጃ አልሰጡም። የአሜሪካ መንግስት እስካሁን በጉዳዩ ላይ ምንም አይነት ይፋዊ መግለጫ አልሰጠም።
oromo: Humnooni tiksee jijjiiramaa Iraan (IRGC) galaana Hormuz biratti doonii Amerikaa kan namni hin oofne tokko to'annaa jala oolchuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Aangoonni Iraan dooniin kun ergama hamaa qabatee akka ture kan himatan yoo ta'u, gama Amerikaatiin garuu hanga ammaa ibsi kenname hin jiru.

title: Will Trump pay all US adults $5,000? Some Trump supporters are sceptical
english: Donald Trump has promised to distribute $5,000 to every American adult if the Republican Party secures control of both the House and Senate in the upcoming midterm elections. While some of his allies support the idea, many observers and political figures have expressed skepticism regarding the proposal's legality and the massive $1 trillion impact on the federal budget. Critics warn that such a plan could destabilize the economy by fueling inflation and lacks a clear strategy for implementation.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ በመካከለኛው ምርጫ የሁለቱንም የህግ አውጪ አካላት ቁጥጥር ካሸነፉ ለእያንዳንዱ አሜሪካዊ 5,000 ዶላር እንደሚሰጡ ቃል ገብተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ በርካታ ታዛቢዎች ይህ ሀሳብ ህጋዊነትን የሚጋፋ ከመሆኑም በላይ ከ1 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ወጪ የሚጠይቅ በመሆኑ የሀገሪቱን በጀት እና ኢኮኖሚ እንደሚያውክ በመግለጽ ጥርጣሬያቸውን እየገለጹ ነው። ተቺዎች ዕቅዱ ግልጽ የሆነ የአፈጻጸም ስልት እንደሌለው እና የዋጋ ግሽበትን ሊያባብስ እንደሚችል ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Donald Trump yoo paartiin isaa filannoo giddu galeessaatti injifatee mana maree lamaanuu to’ate, lammiilee Ameerikaa hundaaf doolaara 5,000 kennuuf waadaa galeera. Ta’us, namoonni hedduun fi ogeeyyiin siyaasaa yaanni kun seeraan ala ta’uu fi baajata mootummaa irratti gatii guddaa tiriliyoona tokkoo olii waan qabuuf, akkasumas diinagdee biyyattii waan miidhuuf shakkiin isaanii guddaadha. Qeeqtoonni akka jedhanitti, karoori kun karoorfamee kan hin qophoofne ta’uu isaa fi gatii meeshaalee garmalee dabaluun diinagdee biyyattii balaaf saaxiluu danda’a.

title: Israeli film on Gaza receives 25-minute ovation at Venice premiere
english: The documentary NAZA, directed by Israeli filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, earned a 25-minute standing ovation at the Venice Film Festival. The film features testimony from anonymous intelligence sources detailing how the Israeli military used AI-driven systems to identify and target individuals in Gaza. These whistleblowers described a mechanized, large-scale process that resulted in significant civilian casualties and the destruction of homes.
amharic: በእስራኤላውያን ባለሙያዎች ዩቫል አብርሃም እና ራሄል ዞር የተዘጋጀው ናዛ የተሰኘው ዘጋቢ ፊልም በቬኒስ ፊልም ፌስቲቫል ላይ የ25 ደቂቃ የቆይታ አድናቆት አግኝቷል። ፊልሙ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በጋዛ ኢላማዎችን ለመምታት አርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስን እንዴት እንደሚጠቀም የሚገልጹ የቀድሞ የስለላ ሰራተኞችን ምስክርነት ያቀርባል። እነዚህ ምስክሮች የቴክኖሎጂ አጠቃቀሙ በሰፊው የሲቪል ህዝብ ላይ ጉዳት እና የቤት መውደም ማስከተሉን በዝርዝር አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Filmiin NAZA jedhamu kan hoogganoota fiilmii Israa'el Yuvaal Abraaham fi Raheel Zooriin qophaa'e, paarkii fiilmii Veeniis irratti daqiiqaa 25f hiriiraan deeggarameera. Fiilmiin kun ragaa namoota tajaajila iccitii Israa'el keessa hojjechaa turanii fi waraanni Israa'el meeshaalee 'Artificial Intelligence' fayyadamuu isaa ibsan qabata. Ragaan kun akka ibsutti, sirni kun lafa bal'aa irratti namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu fi manneen barbadeessuu akka hordofsiise ibsa.

title: A year after Charlie Kirk’s death, are young voters turning on Trump?
english: One year after the assassination of conservative activist Charlie Kirk, his organization Turning Point USA has significantly expanded its influence across American campuses. Despite this growth in organizational reach, support for Donald Trump among young men has noticeably declined due to economic struggles and frustration with current foreign policies. These shifting political attitudes present a challenge for the Republican Party as they navigate young voters' concerns over inflation and the ongoing conflict involving Iran.
amharic: የቀኝ ዘመም አክቲቪስት ቻርሊ ኪርክ ከተገደሉ አንድ ዓመት በኋላ፣ እርሳቸው የመሠረቱት ተርኒንግ ፖይንት ዩኤስኤ የተባለ ድርጅት በአሜሪካ የትምህርት ተቋማት ውስጥ ያለውን ተጽዕኖ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ አስፍቷል። ይሁን እንጂ የድርጅቱ መስፋፋት ቢኖርም፣ በኢኮኖሚ ጫና እና በውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲዎች ባላቸው ቅሬታ ምክንያት በወጣት ወንዶች ዘንድ ለዶናልድ ትራምፕ ያለው ድጋፍ ቀንሷል። እነዚህ እየተቀያየሩ ያሉ የፖለቲካ አመለካከቶች፣ ወጣት መራጮች በዋጋ ግሽበት እና በኢራን ጦርነት ላይ ያላቸውን ስጋት ለመፍታት ለሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ፈተና ሆነዋል።
oromo: Duulaa mirgaa Chaarlii Kirk erga ajjeefamanii waggaa tokko booda, dhaabbanni isaan hundeesse 'Turning Point USA' jedhamu dameewwan isaa manneen barnootaa Ameerikaa hedduu keessatti bal'iseera. Dhaabbatichi guddina kan argate ta'us, dhimmoota dinagdee fi siyaasa alaa irratti yaaddoo qabaniin walqabatee, dargaggoota dhiiraa biratti deeggarsi Donald Trump irratti qaban gadi bu'eera. Jijjiiramni siyaasaa kun, dargaggoonni gatii dabuu fi waraana Iraan irratti yaaddoo qaban akka furuuf paartii Rippaabilikaanotaa irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jira.

title: Israel says it destroyed Hezbollah base in Lebanon’s Ali al-Taher ridge
english: The Israeli military announced it has destroyed a major underground Hezbollah base located at the Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon. This site served as a command center and weapons storage facility for the militant group's Badr unit. Israeli officials stated they plan to maintain control over the area to prevent Hezbollah from returning or rebuilding its military capabilities.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በአሊ አል-ታሂር ተራራ ላይ የሚገኘውን የሂዝቦላህን ዋና የመሬት ውስጥ መሠረተ ልማት ማውደሙን አስታውቋል። ይህ ቦታ ለቡድኑ የባድር ክፍል እንደ ዋና የትዕዛዝ ማዕከል እና የጦር መሳሪያ ማከማቻ ሆኖ ያገለግል ነበር። የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ሂዝቦላህ ወደ አካባቢው ተመልሶ እንዳይደራጅ ለመከላከል ወታደሮቻቸው በስፍራው እንደሚቆዩ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el, buufata waraana Hizballaah kan lafa jalaa guddaa naannoo Ali al-Taher, kibba Libaanoositti argamu barbadeessuu isaa beeksiseera. Bakki kun garee kanaaf akka bakka ajajaatti fi bakka kuusaa meeshaa waraanaatti kan tajaajilaa ture dha. Mootummaan Israa'el, Hizballaah naannoo kana deebi'ee akka hin qabanne fi humna isaa akka hin ijaarre ittisuuf, waraanni isaanii naannicha to'annaa isaanii jala akka turu ibseera.

title: Spain’s Parliament backs citizenship for Western Saharans born before 1977
english: Spain's lower house of parliament has passed a bill offering citizenship to Western Saharans born before September 1977 and their children. This legislation aims to rectify historical grievances from the period of Spanish colonial rule in the territory. While the bill still requires approval from the Senate, it could potentially benefit over 70,000 people living in the region or abroad.
amharic: የስፔን የሕዝብ ተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ከሴፕቴምበር 1977 በፊት ለተወለዱ የምዕራብ ሳህራ ተወላጆች እና ልጆቻቸው ዜግነት የሚሰጥ ረቂቅ ሕግ አጽድቋል። ይህ እርምጃ ስፔን በክልሉ የነበራትን የቅኝ ግዛት ታሪካዊ በደል ለማረም ያለመ ነው። ረቂቅ ሕጉ አሁንም በሴኔቱ መጽደቅ ያለበት ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ ወይም በውጭ የሚኖሩ ከ70,000 በላይ ሰዎች ተጠቃሚ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ።
oromo: Mana maree bakka bu'oota sabaa Ispeen, namoota weerara Ispeen dura bara 1977 dura dhalatanifi ijoollee isaaniitiif lammummaa kennuuf seera tokko raggaasiseera. Seerri kun gocha seenaa darbe keessa Ispeen naannicharratti raawwatte sirreessuuf kan qophaaye dha. Seerichi gara fuulduraatti seeneetiif dhihaatee raggaasifamuu kan qabu yoo ta'u, namoota 70,000 ol ta'an fayyadamoo taasisuu danda'a.

title: LG defends smart-TV features amid audio surveillance allegations
english: LG has publicly denied claims that its smart televisions secretly record private conversations while in standby mode. The company states that audio is only captured when a user specifically activates voice recognition features and that all other data is promptly erased. This response follows an investigation by tech researchers alleging that LG TVs harvest excessive user data and potentially monitor ambient noise even when idle.
amharic: ኤልጂ (LG) ኩባንያ ስማርት ቴሌቪዥኖቹ ተጠቃሚዎች በማይጠቀሙበት ጊዜ የግል ንግግሮችን በስውር ይመዘግባሉ የሚለውን ውንጀላ አስተባብሏል። ኩባንያው ድምፅ የሚቀዳው ተጠቃሚዎች የድምፅ ማወቂያ ተግባሩን ሲያነቃቁ ብቻ እንደሆነና ሌሎች መረጃዎች ወዲያውኑ እንደሚጠፉ ገልጿል። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው የቴክኖሎጂ ተመራማሪዎች የኤልጂ ቴሌቪዥኖች ተጠቃሚዎችን ያለፈቃድ እንደሚከታተሉ እና ድምፅ እንደሚቀዱ ባቀረቡት ምርመራ ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Kampaniin LG bilbiloota isaa (smart TV) yeroo hin fayyadamnetti haasaa icitii namaa galchu jechuun himannaa dhiyaateef haaleera. LG akka ibsetti, sagaleen kan galfamu yeroo fayyadamtoonni itti yaadanii amala sagalee beekuu (voice recognition) fayyadamanii qofa yoo ta'u, ragaan biraa immoo battalumatti haqama. Ibsi kun kan dhufe qorattoonni teknoloojii LG bilbiloota isaa fayyadamtoota hordofuu fi sagalee naannawaa galchuuf fayyadamuu akka danda'an gabaasuu isaanii hordofee dha.

title: Peru joins US-led ‘Shield of the Americas’ security alliance
english: Peru has officially joined the US-led 'Shield of the Americas' security alliance to strengthen its fight against drug cartels and transnational crime. The country's president, Keiko Fujimori, announced the partnership following discussions with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio. This initiative focuses on increasing military cooperation and intelligence sharing to combat criminal groups that threaten national sovereignty.
amharic: ፔሩ በአሜሪካ የሚመራው የ'ሺልድ ኦፍ ዘ አሜሪካስ' የጸጥታ ጥምረት አባል ሆናለች። ይህ ስምምነት አገሪቱ በአደንዛዥ ዕፅ አዘዋዋሪዎች እና በወንጀለኞች ላይ የምታደርገውን ትግል ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። የፔሩ ፕሬዚዳንት ኬይኮ ፉጂሞሪ ከአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ጋር ከተወያዩ በኋላ፣ ሁለቱ አገራት በወታደራዊ ስልጠና እና በመረጃ ልውውጥ ለመተባበር መስማማታቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Peru waldaa nageenyaa 'Shield of the Americas' jedhamu kan Ameerikaan durfamu keessatti hirmaachuuf walii galteetti. Walta'iinsi kun kan kaayyeffate gargaarsa waraanaa fi wal jijjiirraa odeeffannoo fayyadamuun garee yakka raawwattootaa fi gabaa qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochu irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuudha. Preezidaantittiin Peru Keiko Fujimori, Ministeera Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo wajjin mari’achuun hojii waloo kana kan ifoomsite yoo ta’u, kunis nageenya biyyattii fi naannichaa mirkaneessuuf kan gargaaru ta’uu ibsameera.

title: Oil shortage shuts main generator at Gaza’s Al-Ahli Arab Hospital
english: The primary generator at Gaza's Al-Ahli Arab Hospital has failed because the facility has run out of fuel and necessary replacement parts. This emergency has forced the hospital to halt key diagnostic services, including the only CT scanner in the northern region, and delay critical surgical procedures. The institution is now on the verge of total operational collapse and is pleading for immediate aid to continue providing life-saving care.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኘው የአል-አህሊ አረብ ሆስፒታል ነዳጅ እና መለዋወጫ ዕቃዎች በማለቁ ዋናው ኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫው መስራት አቁሟል። በዚህ ችግር ምክንያት ሆስፒታሉ የሲቲ ስካን አገልግሎትን ጨምሮ ወሳኝ የምርመራ ክፍሎቹን መዝጋት የተገደደ ሲሆን፣ ቀጠሮ ተይዞላቸው የነበሩ ቀዶ ጥገናዎችም ተስተጓጉለዋል። የሆስፒታሉ አገልግሎት ሙሉ ለሙሉ ሊቋረጥ ስለሚችል፣ ድርጅቱ አስቸኳይ የሰብአዊ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግለት ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Hospitaalli Al-Ahli Arab kan Gaaza keessatti argamu, dhabamuun boba'aa fi meeshaalee bakka buufaman irraa kan ka'e, jeneraatarri inni guddaan dhaabbatee jira. Rakkoo kana hordofee, hospitaalli kun tajaajila kaameeraa fi CT scan dabalatee tajaajiloota fayyaa barbaachisoo ta'an dhaabuufi ogeeyyiin wal'ansa fayyaa kanneen akka baqaqsanii hodhuu (surgery) yeroof dabarsuuf dirqamaniiru. Hospitaalli kun guutummaatti cufuuf waan ga'eef, tajaajila fayyaa itti fufsiisuuf gargaarsa ariifachiisaa barbaada.

title: Palestinian engineer killed in Israeli attack in Gaza's Khan Younis
english: A Palestinian engineer named Hudaifa Hamdi Mamar was recently killed during an Israeli military strike in the Al Mawasi district of Khan Younis. This incident occurred alongside another attack on the same day that resulted in the deaths of a family of four, including two young children. These events highlight the ongoing violence and civilian casualties reported in residential areas of Gaza.
amharic: ሁዳይፋ ሃምዲ ማማር የተባሉ ፍልስጤማዊ መሐንዲስ በጋዛ ካን ዩኒስ በደረሰ የእስራኤል ጥቃት ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በዚሁ ቀን በደረሰ ሌላ ጥቃት ሁለት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ የአንድ ቤተሰብ አራት አባላት መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በጋዛ የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎች እየደረሰ ያለውን የሲቪል ህዝብ ጉዳት ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Injiniarri Palastinii tokko maqaan isaanii Hudaifa Hamdi Mamar jedhamu, haleellaa waraana Israa'el ganda Al-Mawasi kan Kaann Yuunis keessatti geggeeffameen ajjeefamaniiru. Guyyaa sanuma haleellaa biraatiin maatii afur, ijoollee lama dabalatee, du'uun gabaasameera. Taateewwan kun naannolee jireenyaa Gaazaa keessatti miidhaa siviloota irra gahaa jiru agarsiisu.

title: Israeli strike destroys family home in southern Lebanon
english: An Israeli airstrike has leveled a residential house located between the villages of Haris and Hadatha in southern Lebanon. The attack took place within the Tyre district, according to reports from the National News Agency. There were no immediate details provided regarding potential casualties resulting from the destruction of the property.
amharic: የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙት ሃሪስ እና ሃዳታ መንደሮች መካከል የሚገኝ የመኖሪያ ቤት ሙሉ በሙሉ ማውደሙ ተዘግቧል። የብሔራዊ የዜና አገልግሎት እንደገለጸው ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በጢሮስ አውራጃ ውስጥ ነው። በዚህ የጥቃት ክስተት ስለደረሰው የሰው ህይወት ጉዳት እስካሁን የተገለጸ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Humni qilleensa Israa'el gammoojjii Kibba Libaanositti argaman ganda Haaris fi Haadataa jidduutti argamu tokko guutummaatti barbadeesseera. Gabaasni ejansii oduu biyyoolessaa akka ibsetti, miidhaan kun kan gahe naannoo Tiir keessatti dha. Haleellaa kana hordofee miidhaa lubbuu qaqqabe ilaalchisee hanga ammaatti odeeffannoon kenname hin jiru.

title: Pro-Palestine activist wins mayoral Democratic primary in Rhode Island
english: David Morales, a 27-year-old state representative and vocal advocate for Palestinian rights, has secured a victory in the Democratic mayoral primary in Providence, Rhode Island. Despite having a significantly smaller campaign budget than his opponent, he successfully unseated the incumbent mayor. Morales is now positioned to become the youngest mayor in the city's history following the general election in November.
amharic: የ27 ዓመቱ የክልል ተወካይ እና የፍልስጤማውያን መብት ተሟጋች የሆኑት ዴቪድ ሞራሌስ፣ በሮድ አይላንድ ፕሮቪደንስ ከተማ በተካሄደው የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫ አሸንፈዋል። ከተቃዋሚያቸው ያነሰ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ቢኖራቸውም፣ ነባሩን ከንቲባ በመርታት ድል መቀዳጀት ችለዋል። በዚህም በህዳር ወር በሚካሄደው ጠቅላላ ምርጫ አሸናፊ ከሆኑ፣ በከተማዋ ታሪክ ትንሹ ከንቲባ ይሆናሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Deeggaraan mirga Falasxiinotaa fi bakka bu'aan mootummaa kan ta'an umuriin isaanii 27 kan ta'e Deevid Moraalees, mooraa Paartii Deemookraatikitti magaalaa Piroovidans, Rood Aayilaandiitti injifannoo argataniiru. Baajata duula filannoo morkataa isaanii irraa xiqqaa qabaatus, kantiibaa amma jiru mo'achuun milkaa'aniiru. Moraalees filannoo sadaasaa irratti yoo injifatan, seenaa magaalaattis kantiibaa umuriin isaanii baay'ee xiqqaa ta'e ta'uun isaanii ni eeggama.

title: Israeli strike in Gaza kills family of four, including children
english: An Israeli military airstrike in the northern Gaza Strip resulted in the deaths of four family members, including two children aged eight and twelve. The attack occurred at a residential home located in the Beit Lahia Project area. Local hospital officials confirmed the recovery of the bodies following the strike, which the Israeli military has acknowledged.
amharic: በሰሜናዊ ጋዛ ሰርጥ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ሁለት ሕፃናትን ጨምሮ የአንድ ቤተሰብ አራት አባላት መገደላቸው ተሰምቷል። ጥቃቱ የደረሰው በቤይት ላሂያ ፕሮጀክት አካባቢ በሚገኝ መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ ነው። የሆስፒታል ምንጮች የሟቾቹን አስከሬን ማግኘታቸውን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይልም ጥቃቱን ፈጽመናል ብሎ አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gammoojjii Gaaza kaabaatti qilleensaan haleellaa geggeesseen ijoollee lama dabalatee miseensonni maatii tokko afur du'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame mana jireenyaa naannoo Beet Laahiyaa jedhamu keessatti dha. Ogeeyyonni hospitaalaa reeffa namoota miidhaan irra ga'ee du'an argachuu mirkaneessaniiru; waraanni Israa'elis haleellaa kana raawwachuu isaa ibseera.

title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
english: A devastating fire broke out at two schools in Bukavu, Democratic Republic of Congo, resulting in at least 24 student deaths during a panicked stampede to escape. The blaze also destroyed hundreds of homes in the crowded area, and officials worry the number of fatalities may continue to climb as search efforts progress. While the exact cause remains unknown, authorities have expressed deep sorrow and are launching investigations into the tragedy.
amharic: በዴሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ ቡካዉ ከተማ በሚገኙ ሁለት ትምህርት ቤቶች በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ 24 ተማሪዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ተማሪዎቹ ከእሳቱ ለመውጣት በሞከሩበት ወቅት በተፈጠረ የህዝብ መገፋፋት አደጋው የከፋ ሆኗል። እሳቱ ከትምህርት ቤቶቹ በተጨማሪ በሰፈሩ ውስጥ የሚገኙ በርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን ያወደመ ሲሆን፣ የሟቾች ቁጥር ሊጨምር እንደሚችል ተሰግቷል። የእሳት አደጋው መንስኤ እስካሁን ያልታወቀ ሲሆን፣ መንግስትም በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ አዟል።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti, magaalaa Bukavuu keessatti mana barumsaa lama irratti ibidda ka'een barattoonni 24 ol ta'an lubbuun darbaniiru. Barattoonni kun ibidda irraa baqachuuf yeroo yaalanitti, wal-irra ejjetamuu irraa kan ka'e balaan kun hammaateera. ibiddisi kun manneen jireenyaa hedduu kan barbadeesse yoo ta'u, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii dabaluu akka danda'u sodaan jira. Sababni ibiddaa hanga ammaa kan hin beekamne yoo ta'u, mootummaan qorannoo gochuuf murteesseera.

title: Gaza hospitals ration power as fuel shortages deepen
english: Hospitals in Gaza are being forced to limit their electricity usage due to a severe shortage of fuel and engine oil. This energy crisis is causing frequent power outages that threaten the lives of patients relying on medical equipment. Healthcare workers are raising urgent alarms as these conditions make it increasingly difficult to provide necessary life-saving care.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ሆስፒታሎች በነዳጅ እና በቅባት እጥረት ምክንያት የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦትን ለመቀነስ ተገደዋል። ይህ የኃይል ችግር በህክምና መሳሪያዎች ላይ ጥገኛ የሆኑ ታማሚዎችን ህይወት ለአደጋ እያጋለጠ ያለ ተደጋጋሚ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥን አስከትሏል። የህክምና ባለሙያዎች ይህ ሁኔታ ህይወት አድን አገልግሎቶችን ለመስጠት ከፍተኛ ተግዳሮት እንደፈጠረባቸው በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Buufataaleen fayyaa Gaazaa keessa jiran hanqina boba'aa fi zayita injinii hamaa mudateen walqabatee fayyadama ibsaa hir'isuuf dirqamaniiru. Hanqinni anniisaa kun kutannoo ibsaa deddeebi'ee mudatuun, meeshaalee fayyaa irratti kan hundaa'an dhukkubsattootaaf balaa guddaa fideera. Ogeeyyonni fayyaa haalli kun tajaajila lubbuu baraaruu kennuuf rakkoo cimaa uumuusaa ibsuun yaaddoo qaban himataniiru.

title: Russian strike hits shopping centre in central Ukraine
english: A Russian missile strike on a shopping mall in the Ukrainian city of Pavlohrad has resulted in at least four deaths and left 60 people injured. This incident is part of an intensifying trend where both sides are launching long-range attacks against civilian infrastructure. The situation highlights the growing danger to non-combatants as the conflict continues to escalate.
amharic: በዩክሬን ከተማ ፓቭሎግራድ በሚገኝ የገበያ ማዕከል ላይ የሩሲያ የሮኬት ጥቃት በመሰንዘሩ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፤ ከ60 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ሁለቱም ወገኖች ከጦር ግንባር በራቁ አካባቢዎች በሚገኙ የሲቪል ተቋማት ላይ ጥቃቶችን እያጠናከሩ በመምጣታቸው የተከሰተ ነው። ግጭቱ እየተባባሰ በሄደ ቁጥር በሲቪል ነዋሪዎች ላይ የሚደርሰው ስጋትም እየጨመረ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Magaalaa Yukreen Paavlogiraaditti bakka gabaa tokko irratti rukuttaa rookeetiin Raashiyaan raawwattee namoota afur ajjeesee, kanneen biroo 60 immoo miidheera. Haleellaan kun kan agarsiisu, gamtaan lameenuu dirree waraanaarraa fagaatanii iddoo namoonni nagaan itti argaman irratti haleellaa cimaa gaggeessaa akka jiranidha. Walitti bu'iinsi kun yeroodhaa gara yerootti jabaachaa waan deemuuf, jireenyi namoota nagaa balaa guddaa keessa galeera.

title: Drones recreate Twin Towers in tribute ahead of 9/11 anniversary
english: In preparation for the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks, thousands of drones were flown to light up the sky in the shape of the fallen Twin Towers. The display featured 2,977 individual lights, with each one representing a life lost during the tragic events. This aerial memorial serves as a solemn tribute to honor the victims as the anniversary approaches.
amharic: የመስከረም 11 ጥቃት 25ኛ ዓመት መታሰቢያን አስመልክቶ፣ የጠፉትን መንታ ህንጻዎች ቅርጽ በድሮን በመጠቀም በሰማይ ላይ እንደገና እንዲታዩ ተደርጓል። ይህ ዝግጅት በዕለቱ ህይወታቸውን ላጡ 2,977 ሰዎች መታሰቢያ እንዲሆን፣ ለእያንዳንዳቸው አንድ መብራት በማብራት ተካሂዷል። ይህ የአየር ላይ ስነስርዓት የሟቾችን ቤተሰቦች እና የሀገሪቱን ህዝብ ለማስታወስ የተዘጋጀ ነው።
oromo: Guyyaa yaadannoo haleellaa Siptembar 11ffaa kan 25ffaa ilaalchisee, suuraa gamoowwan 'Twin Towers' jedhaman sana sararoota doroonaa hedduu fayyadamuun samii irratti akka mul'atan taasifameera. Sirna kana keessatti namoota 2,977 haleellaa sanaan du'an yaadachuuf ifaan 2,977 akka ifu ta'eera. Yaadannoon samii irratti taasifame kun namoota lubbuun isaanii darbe kabajuuf kan qophaaye dha.

title: Manchester United beat Sabah 4-0 on Champions League return
english: Manchester United made a successful return to the Champions League by defeating Sabah 4-0 in their tournament opener. Goals from Matheus Cunha, Bruno Fernandes, and Benjamin Sesko established a commanding lead by halftime, while Lisandro Martinez added a final goal in the second half. Although the visitors had a few opportunities to score, United controlled the match to secure a comfortable win at Old Trafford.
amharic: ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ በቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ውድድር ተመልሶ የሳባህን ቡድን 4 ለ 0 በማሸነፍ ብቁ ውጤት አስመዝግቧል። ማቲየስ ኩንሃ፣ ብሩኖ ፈርናንዴዝ እና ቤንጃሚን ሴስኮ በግማሽ ሰዓት ጨዋታ ውስጥ ግቦቹን በማስቆጠር ቡድኑን መሪ አድርገው ነበር፣ ሊሳንድሮ ማርቲኔዝ ደግሞ በሁለተኛው አጋማሽ አራተኛውን ግብ ጨምሯል። እንግዶቹ የጎል ሙከራዎችን ቢያደርጉም፣ ዩናይትድ የጨዋታውን ሂደት በመቆጣጠር በሜዳው ኦልድ ትራፎርድ የድል ባለቤት ሆኗል።
oromo: Manchester United taphatoota Chaampiyoons Liigii irratti deebi'anii taphataniin garee Sabah 4-0 injifachuu danda'aniiru. Goonni maatii Maatewos Kunhaa, Birunoo Farnaandeez fi Beenyamiin Seeskoo akkaataa daqiiqaa 45 keessatti hoggansa cimaa akka argatan godheera, akkasumas Liisaandroo Maartiineez walakkaa lammaffaa irratti goolii dabalataa galcheera. Gareen morkataa carraa xiqqoo argatee tureellee, Manchester United iddoo tapha isaanii Ooldi Traaford irratti injifannoo salphaa argachuu danda'eera.

title: Morocco denies involvement in migrant surge into Spain’s Ceuta
english: Morocco has formally rejected accusations that it played a role in the recent mass migration event where over 70,000 people crossed into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. While Spanish opposition groups suspect Rabat of orchestrating the surge, Moroccan officials maintain that no evidence supports these claims and have criticized the handling of the migrants currently in Spain. The incident, which resulted in over 100 deaths and ongoing local unrest, remains a point of significant political tension ahead of Spain's upcoming national elections.
amharic: ሞሮኮ ከ70,000 በላይ ስደተኞች ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ በገቡበት አጋጣሚ እጇ እንዳለባት የሚነዙትን ወሬዎች አጣጥላለች። የስፔን ተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች ሞሮኮ ይህን እንቅስቃሴ አስተባብራለች ብለው ቢከሱም፣ የሞሮኮ መንግስት ግን ይህንን የሚደግፍ ማስረጃ እንደሌለ በመግለጽ ውንጀላውን አስተባብሯል። ከ100 በላይ ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን በገበሩበት በዚህ ክስተት ምክንያት በአካባቢው ከፍተኛ አለመረጋጋት የተፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ በስፔን የውስጥ ፖለቲካ ውስጥም ውዝግብ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Marookoo, namootni 70,000 ol ta'an gara daangaa Ispeen, Si'uutaa (Ceuta) seenuu isaaniitiin walqabatee himannaa irratti dhiyaateef fudhatama dhabsiiseera. Gareewwan mormituu Ispeen Marookoon godaansa kana qindeessiteetti jedhanii yoo himatan, mootummaan Marookoo garuu himannaan kun ragaa kan hin qabneefi siyaasaaf kan oolu dha jechuun deebiseera. Namoota 100 ol lubbuun isaanii darbeefi godaantota achi keessatti hafan irratti mootummaan Ispeen tajaajila gaarii hin kennine jechuun Marookoon komatteerti.

title: Can Trump really pay $5,000 to every American adult?
english: Donald Trump has promised a $5,000 payment to every American adult if Republicans secure a victory in the upcoming midterm elections. While Vice President JD Vance suggested funding the plan through tariffs, critics view the proposal as an unrealistic and legally questionable campaign tactic. Experts are divided on whether this move constitutes an illegal bribe or a standard political pledge to lower taxes, while concerns remain regarding the massive $1.3 trillion price tag.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ በመጪው የምርጫ ጊዜ ድል ከተቀዳጀ፣ ለእያንዳንዱ አሜሪካዊ አዋቂ 5,000 ዶላር እንደሚሰጡ ቃል ገብተዋል። ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ይህንን ፕሮግራም በታሪፍ ገቢ ለመሸፈን ማቀዳቸውን ቢጠቁሙም፣ ተቺዎች ግን ይህንን ሀሳብ የማይቻል እና ህጋዊነት የሚጠየቅበት የፖለቲካ ማባበያ ብለውታል። ባለሙያዎች ጉዳዩ ህገ-ወጥ ጉቦ ነው ወይስ እንደ ታክስ ቅነሳ አይነት ተራ የምርጫ ቃል የሚል ክርክር እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ፕሮጀክቱ የሚጠይቀው 1.3 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር የገንዘብ ምንጭም ጥያቄ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Donald Trump yoo paartiin isaa filannoo dhufu irratti injifate, lammiilee Ameerikaa ga’eessota ta’an hundaaf qarshii 5,000 akka kennu waadaa seeneera. Preezdaantitti-aanaan JD Vance baasii kana taariffii irraa argamuun qofaa akka qabaniif dubbatanis, mormitoonni garuu waadaan kun kan hin raawwanneefi seera qabeessummaan isaas kan shakkamu akka ta’e dubbatu. Hayyoonni tokko tokko waadaan kun akka badhaasaa seeraan alaa (bribes) ilaalamu yoo qabu, kaan ammoo akka waadaa siyaasaa idilee kan gibira hir’isuu waliin kan wal fakkaatu ta’uu dubbatu; ta’us, baasii guddaa tiriliyoona 1.3 ga’u kana akkamitti akka guutamu ifa miti.

title: Jimmy Kimmel moves Senate interview to YouTube in latest collision with FCC
english: Talk show host Jimmy Kimmel moved his interview with Texas Senate candidate James Talarico to YouTube after the FCC determined that late-night programs no longer qualify for exemptions from equal-time political broadcast rules. Kimmel claims this decision is a form of intimidation from the Republican-led agency aimed at curbing his editorial independence regarding candidate appearances. By bypassing ABC, the show avoids the requirement to provide equal airtime to opposing political candidates during the tight Texas election race.
amharic: የቴሌቪዥን አቅራቢው ጂሚ ಕಿሜል ከቴክሳስ የሴኔት እጩ ከጄምስ ታላሪኮ ጋር ያደረገውን ቃለ መጠይቅ ወደ ዩቲዩብ አስተላልፎታል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰደው የፌዴራል ኮሙዩኒኬሽን ኮሚሽን (FCC) የሌሊት መዝናኛ ፕሮግራሞች ለፖለቲካዊ እኩል የአየር ሰዓት ህግ ተገዢ መሆን አለባቸው በማለቱ ነው። ጂሚ ಕಿሜል ይህ የሪፐብሊካኖች አስተዳደር የራሱን የፕሮግራም አወጣጥ ነፃነት ለመገደብ የሚጠቀምበት ማስፈራሪያ ነው ሲል ይከሳል።
oromo: Hogganaan sagantaa televizyinii Jimmi Kimmeel marii isaa kan sagalee kaadhimamaa seeneetii Teeksaas Jeems Taalaarikoo waliin taasise gara Yuutubii geesseera. Murtuun kun kan dhufte, komishiniin quunnamtii federaalaa (FCC) sagantaaleen halkan darban seera yeroo walqixa ta'e kaadhimamtootaaf kennuu qabu jedhu keessaa bilisa akka hin taane murteessuusaatiin kan ka'e dha. Jimmi Kimmeel tarkaanfiin FCC kun mootummaa ammayyaa biraa sagantaa isaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf kan karoorfameefi walaba ta'uusaatti kan gufuu uumu akka ta'e dubbateera.

title: Amnesty accuses Russia of trafficking foreigners to fight in Ukraine
english: Amnesty International has released a report accusing Russia of human trafficking by deceiving foreigners into joining its military for the war in Ukraine. According to the report, individuals from countries including Brazil, Sri Lanka, and South Africa were lured with false job offers, only to be forced into combat roles upon arrival. These vulnerable foreign nationals were coerced into signing military contracts and deprived of their freedom of movement.
amharic: የአምነስቲ ኢንተርናሽናል አዲስ ሪፖርት ሩሲያ የውጭ ዜጎችን በስራ ዕድል በማታለል ለዩክሬን ጦርነት እንዲዋጉ በማስገደድ የሰዎች ዝውውር ወንጀል እንደፈጸመች ከሷል። እንደ ዘገባው ከሆነ ከብራዚል፣ ከስሪላንካ እና ከደቡብ አፍሪካ የመጡ ሰዎች አታላይ በሆነ የሥራ ማስታወቂያ ወደ ሩሲያ ተወስደው በኃይል በጦር ሠራዊቱ ውስጥ እንዲገቡ ተደርገዋል። እነዚህ ተጎጂዎች የውትድርና ውል እንዲፈርሙ ተገደው የመንቀሳቀስ ነጻነታቸው እንደተገፈፈም ሪፖርቱ ያሳያል።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraa Amnaastii Intarnaashinalii akka jedhutti, Raashiyaan namoota biyyoota alaa hojii argannaan gowwoomsuudhaan waraana Yukreen irratti akka hirmaatan dirqisiifteetti. Namoonni biyyoota akka Braazil, Sriilaankaa fi Afrikaa Kibbaa irraa dhufan, waadaa hojii sobaa kanaan erga Raashiyaa galanii booda, humnaan waraana keessa akka seenan godhamaniiru. Namoonni kun kan dirqisiifaman ta'uu fi mirgi sochiin isaanii akka daangeffame gabaasichi ibseera.

title: Fire onboard ship at Chinese shipyard kills 25 people
english: A fire broke out on a Liberia-registered vessel while it was undergoing maintenance at a shipyard in Qingdao, China, resulting in the deaths of at least 25 people. Following the tragedy, Chinese President Xi Jinping has demanded a rapid and thorough investigation to determine the cause and hold those responsible accountable. Authorities are currently looking into the circumstances surrounding the incident.
amharic: በቻይና ቺንግዳኦ ከተማ በሚገኝ የመርከብ መጠገኛ ጣቢያ ውስጥ ጥገና እየተደረገለት በነበረ ላይቤሪያ በተመዘገበ መርከብ ላይ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ 25 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የቻይናው ፕሬዚዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማጣራትና ተጠያቂዎችን ለፍርድ ለማቅረብ ፈጣን ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል። ባለሥልጣናት በአሁኑ ወቅት በአደጋው ዙሪያ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Chaayinaa magaalaa Qingdao keessatti doonii liiberiyaan galmaa’e tokko irratti hojiin suphuu geggeeffamaa osoo jiruu ibiddi ka’ee namoonni 25 ol du’aniiru. Preezidaant Siin Jiinping balaa kana hordofee qorannoo ariifataa taasisuun namoota gocha kanaaf itti gaafatamummaa qaban seeratti akka dhiyaatan ajajaniiru. Aangeyyoonni mootummaa haala balaa kanaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: England close in on Pakistan whitewash in third Test as Robinson shines
english: England is on the verge of completing a 3-0 series sweep against Pakistan after a dominant performance in the third Test at Edgbaston. Bowler Ollie Robinson played a crucial role by taking two quick wickets, leaving Pakistan struggling at 52-2 when rain interrupted play. To avoid an innings defeat, Pakistan still needs 268 more runs in their second innings.
amharic: በኤጅባስተን በተካሄደው ሶስተኛው የሙከራ ግጥሚያ እንግሊዝ ፓኪስታንን 3-0 በሆነ ውጤት ለማሸነፍ ተቃርባለች። የቡድኑ አሳዳጅ ኦሊ ሮቢንሰን ሁለት ፈጣን ውድቀቶችን በማስመዝገብ ፓኪስታንን አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ጥሏቸዋል። በዝናብ ምክንያት ጨዋታው ቀደም ብሎ ቢቆምም፣ ፓኪስታን ሽንፈትን ለመቀልበስ በቀጣይ 268 ተጨማሪ ሩጫዎችን ማስቆጠር ይጠበቅባቸዋል።
oromo: Ingliiziin tapha qormaata sadaffaa Edgbastonitti gaggeeffamaa jiruun Paakistaaniin 3-0 mo'achuuf qophoofteetti. Garee Ingliiz keessaa Olle Roobinsan gadi baasuudhaan Paakistaan 52-2 akka taatu gochuun isaa garee sana rakkoo cimaa keessa galcheera. Roobni harka walakaatti taphicha dhaabsisus, Paakistaan injifannoo Ingliiz hir'isuuf ykn mo'atamuu hambisuuf ammallee fiigicha 268 argachuu qabu.

title: More than a dozen children killed in fire in eastern DR Congo schools
english: A tragic fire has broken out at a school in the eastern region of the Democratic Republic of Congo. The incident resulted in the deaths of over twelve children. Authorities and emergency responders are currently addressing the aftermath of this disaster.
amharic: በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ ምስራቃዊ ክፍል በሚገኝ አንድ ትምህርት ቤት ባጋጠመ የእሳት አደጋ ከአስራ ሁለት በላይ ህጻናት ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ባለስልጣናት እና የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሰራተኞች በአሁኑ ወቅት በአደጋው የተጎዱትን ሁኔታ እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በግልጽ ባልታወቁ ምክንያቶች የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Kibba Baha Rippabiliika Dimokraatawaa Koongoo keessatti mana barumsaa tokko keessatti ibiddi ka'e balaa cimaa geessiseera. Balaa kana keessatti ijoolleen kudha lamaa ol ta'an lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Aangeyyoonni fi gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa balaa kana hordofaa jiru.

title: Huge explosions heard in south Lebanon, report says
english: Powerful explosions recently shook southern Lebanon following an Israeli military operation. Israel stated that the blasts were part of an effort to dismantle underground facilities located near a key ridge in the Nabatieh district. Local reports confirmed that the intensity of the detonations caused significant vibrations throughout the surrounding area.

title: NAZA: Film exposing systematic killing in Gaza gets record 24-minute standing ovation at Venice
english: The documentary NAZA, directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, received a record-breaking 24-minute standing ovation at the Venice Film Festival. The film features interviews with 24 Israeli soldiers who describe the systematic and intentional killing of civilians in Gaza. By highlighting the bureaucratic processes behind these military actions, the directors aim to expose the premeditated nature of the violence occurring in the region.
amharic: በዩቫል አብርሃም እና በራቸል ዞር የተዘጋጀው ናዛ የተሰኘው ዘጋቢ ፊልም በቬኒስ ፊልም ፌስቲቫል ላይ ለ24 ደቂቃ የዘለቀ ታሪካዊ ጭብጨባ ተቸሮለታል። ፊልሙ በጋዛ የሚፈጸመውን የሲቪል ህዝብ ግድያ በስርዓት የተደራጀ እና ሆን ተብሎ የሚደረግ መሆኑን ለማጋለጥ 24 የእስራኤል ወታደሮችን ምስክርነት ይዟል። የፊልሙ አዘጋጆች ይህንን ስራ የሰሩት በወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ጀርባ ያለውን ስሌት እና የአሰራር ሂደት በማሳየት የደረሰውን እልቂት ለማጋለጥ ነው።
oromo: Fiilmiin dokumentarii NAZA jedhamu, kan Yuval Abraham fi Rachel Szor qophaa'e, fiilmiiwwan Venisitti agarsiifaman keessatti rikoordii daqiiqaa 24 guutuu walitti aansuudhaan harka wal-rebuudhaan simatameera. Fiilmichi loltoota Israa'el 24 kan gaafate yoo ta'u, isaanis Gaazaatti lubbuu namoota nagaa ajjeesuun karoorfamee fi sirnaan kan raawwatamu ta'uu isaanii ragaa bahaniiru. Qopheessitoonni fiilmiichaa, tarkaanfiin waraanaa kun akka tasaa osoo hin taane, karooraa fi sirnaan kan geggeeffamu ta'uu isaa addeessuuf akkasumas dararaa raawwatame saaxiluuf kaayyeffataniiru.

title: Opinion: UK settlement trade ban offers a lifeline to Palestine, and to an Israel on the brink
english: The British government is implementing a ban on trade with Israeli settlements located in occupied Palestinian territories to align with international law and recent rulings by the International Court of Justice. This policy shift represents a significant change for the UK, as it acknowledges the illegality of the settlements and differentiates them from recognized Israeli territory. By taking this step alongside other Western nations, Britain is increasingly supporting the Palestinian right to self-determination and upholding UN resolutions.

title: Former New York Mayor Giuliani designated 'anti-Muslim extremist' by Muslim advocacy group
english: The Council on American-Islamic Relations has officially labeled former New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani an anti-Muslim extremist due to his recent inflammatory remarks. During a television interview, Giuliani claimed that Muslims aim to dominate Western society and accused current Mayor Zohran Mamdani of supporting extremists. Muslim advocacy groups condemned these comments as hateful, while Mayor Mamdani chose to focus on honoring the victims of the 9/11 attacks rather than engaging with the criticism.
amharic: የአሜሪካ-እስላማዊ ግንኙነት ምክር ቤት የቀድሞውን የኒውዮርክ ከንቲባ ሩዲ ጁሊያኒ በሰጡት ጥላቻ የተሞላበት አስተያየት ምክንያት እንደ ጸረ-ሙስሊም ጽንፈኛ ፈርጇቸዋል። ጁሊያኒ በቴሌቪዥን ቃለ መጠይቅ ወቅት ሙስሊሞች በምዕራቡ ዓለም ላይ ለመጫን እንደሚሞክሩ በመናገር አሁን ላይ ያሉትን ከንቲባ ዞህራን ማምዳኒን ከሰዋል። የሙስሊም መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች ይህንን ንግግር ያወገዙ ሲሆን፣ ከንቲባ ማምዳኒ ግን ለትችቱ ምላሽ ከመስጠት ይልቅ የሴፕቴምበር 11 የሽብር ጥቃት ሰለባዎችን በማሰብ ላይ ማተኮርን መርጠዋል።

title: IRGC says it targeted unmanned US sea drone in Hormuz
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps recently reported that its navy attempted to seize a solar-powered American surveillance drone in the Strait of Hormuz. This incident follows Iran's claim from the previous day that it had captured an underwater US drone, which American officials dismissed as a mechanical failure. These developments highlight ongoing maritime tensions in the region where the US Fifth Fleet utilizes such unmanned technology for data collection.

oromo: Waraanni Eegumsa Islaamummaa Iraan (IRGC), markaba hawaa irraa to'atamu kan Ameerikaa tokko naannoo Hormuzitti gargar baasuuf yaalii gochuu isaa beeksiseera. Gama biraatiin, waraanni Ameerikaa markabni sun rakkoo tekinikaatiin akka bade ibsuun, ibsa Iraan sun sirrii akka hin taane beeksisaniiru.

title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
english: Houthi forces have gained control of the important Red Sea port city of Mokha following a week of intense fighting against pro-government troops. This advancement puts the group in a stronger position near the vital Bab al-Mandab shipping lane. Simultaneously, escalating tensions have led to Houthi missile strikes on Saudi oil facilities, further intensifying the long-standing conflict and impacting global energy markets.

oromo: Humnooni Huutii torban tokko guutuu waraana cimaa erga geggeessanii booda magaalaa buufata doonii istiraatejikii taate Mokhaa toannoo isaanii jala oolchaniiru. Gochi kun gareen kun karaa doonii gurguddaa kan ta'e handhuura Baab al-Maandaabitti dhihaachuuf gargaareera. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, wal dhabdeen Huutii fi Sa'udii gidduu jiru daran hammaatee, gareen kun buufataalee boba'aa Sa'udii irratti miidiilaan haleellaa geggeessuun gatiin boba'aa addunyaa akka ol ka'u taasiseera.

title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
english: A recent investigation into a fatal Amazon cargo plane crash in Miami revealed that one pilot repeatedly warned their colleague about excessive speed during the final approach. Despite these warnings and automated safety alerts about the aircraft's altitude and descent rate, the plane landed too fast and overshot the runway. The tragic accident resulted in five fatalities and several injuries, with authorities now examining why the cockpit crew did not successfully correct the plane's speed and landing configuration.

title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is taking legal action against the newspaper Haaretz for reporting that he received a pre-attack warning from the UAE regarding Hamas's plans before October 7. Netanyahu’s office has firmly denied these allegations, labeling the report as a malicious conspiracy intended to undermine him. Meanwhile, the newspaper maintains the accuracy of its story, arguing that the lawsuit is an attempt to suppress independent journalism during a critical election period.

title: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
english: A tragic fire on a foreign cargo ship docked in the Chinese port of Qingdao has resulted in the deaths of 25 people. The vessel, which was undergoing maintenance, had 42 people on board at the time, with 17 individuals successfully evacuated. Authorities are currently investigating the cause of the blaze, while top government officials have called for intensive rescue and safety efforts.

Qaamoleen mootummaa Chaayinaa sababa ibiddayyu kanaa qorachuufi hojii barbaachaafi baraarsa cimsanii itti fufuu akka qaban ibsaniiru.

title: US Supreme Court blocks Republican-drawn congressional map in Missouri
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has blocked a Republican-supported plan to redraw Missouri's congressional district maps, effectively requiring the state to use existing maps for the upcoming midterm elections. This decision follows a legal conflict where a state official faced contempt charges for ignoring local court orders regarding which map to follow. The ruling is a significant setback for efforts to shift electoral boundaries in favor of the Republican party.
